source:
You open the door and recoil in horror as the light reflects off a dozen eyes staring at you. It takes you a moment to realize that you’re looking not at a demon but at a strange, almost grotesque set of armor you’ve ever seen.

The helmet reminds you of the murmillo helmet, but it’s perfectly round and much bigger and heavier. There are sixteen eyeholes covered with thick glass, suggesting that the helmet is immovable. Such armor would be worse than useless in combat, yet it was crafted with great care and precision.

There is a single word engraved on it – Aegis.
target_draft:
扉を開けた瞬間、光を反射してこちらを見つめる十数個の目に、あなたは恐怖で身を引く。だが、それが悪魔ではなく、これまで見たこともない奇怪で、ほとんど異様とさえ言える鎧だと気づくまでには少し時間がかかった。

兜はムルミッロの兜を思わせるが、完全な球形で、はるかに大きく重い。厚いガラスで覆われた覗き穴が十六個もあり、この兜が固定されて動かせないことをうかがわせる。戦闘では役に立たないどころか邪魔にしかならないような鎧だが、それでも細部まで丹念かつ精密に作られている。

そこにはただ一語――「Aegis」と刻まれている。

source: [lore success]You remember an old tale of a giant called Aegir who had such a terrifying visage that even beasts and monsters dwelling in the darkest corners of the world were afraid of him. Thus he could travel freely where no other man – not even the greatest of the Magi – could follow.
target_ja: [lore success]あなたは、エーギルという巨人にまつわる古い物語を思い出す。その形相はあまりにも恐ろしく、世界の最も暗い片隅に棲む獣や怪物でさえ彼を恐れたという。そのため彼は、他の誰も――偉大なる魔導士でさえ――踏み込めない場所を自由に旅することができた。

source:

この施設はかなり良好な状態で残っており、奇妙な槽や機械もまだ損なわれていない。

source:
Climbing up proves to be much more challenging than going down. The steps threaten to break off and trigger a sand avalanche that would bury you in seconds. You move slowly and by the time you reach the surface, the sun is long gone and the sky is dark.

The very first thing you see is the bearded loremaster’s dead eyes. His body is lying next to the tower, his unblinking eyes locked on the pyramid. The hacked up bodies of his colleagues, your men, and Aurelian legionaries are strewn around. By the looks of it, your men accounted well for themselves, but the odds weren’t in their favor.

In the distance, five Aurelian legionaries are tending to their wounds near a campfire.
target_ja:
登るのは、下りるよりはるかに骨が折れた。足場は今にも崩れ落ち、砂崩れを起こして数秒であなたを埋めてしまいそうだ。慎重に進んだため、地上にたどり着いた頃には日はとっくに沈み、空は暗くなっていた。

真っ先に目に入ったのは、髭を生やした伝承学者の死んだ目だった。遺体は塔のそばに横たわり、見開かれた目はピラミッドを見つめたままだ。彼の仲間、あなたの部下、そしてアウレリアン軍団兵の切り刻まれた死体が辺り一面に散乱している。見る限り、あなたの部下たちはよく戦ったようだが、多勢に無勢だったらしい。

遠くでは、五人のアウレリアン軍団兵が焚き火のそばで傷の手当てをしている。

source: The legionaries are wounded. Three men have removed their armor and would go down easily, should you choose to attack. The darkness makes it easy to slip away – your brethren will remain unavenged, but you will live, which is a big plus. After all, you dying with them won’t make anyone happier.
target_ja: 軍団兵たちは負傷している。三人は鎧を脱いでおり、攻撃を仕掛ければ簡単に倒せるだろう。闇に紛れてやり過ごすのも容易だ――仲間の仇は討てないが、あなたは生き延びられる。それは大きな利点だ。結局のところ、あなたまで彼らと一緒に死んだところで、誰も喜びはしない。
彼らのそばを忍び抜ける。

source:
This once intricate, rusty metal box contains a well-preserved scroll.

"My name is Quintus Valerius Corvus. I am honored to report that it is my destiny to bring glory to the Empire. I know this for the Senate memorandum assigning me to this project used these very words. The smell of my crucified predecessors lingers in my memory, reminding me that failure isn’t an option. Common sense tells me that success is equally not an option.

"The insane goal of my masters will not - cannot - be achieved, and when the powers that be finally realize this, they will ascribe their own failure to incompetence on my part. Though I may not preserve my life, I will keep these notes both to reinforce my sanity and protect my good name."
target_ja:
かつては精巧な作りだった錆びた金属箱の中に、保存状態の良い巻物が収められている。

「私の名はクィントゥス・ウァレリウス・コルウス。帝国に栄光をもたらすことが我が運命であると、謹んで報告する。そう断言できるのは、私をこの計画に任命した元老院の覚書に、まさにそう記されていたからだ。磔にされた前任者たちの臭いはいまだ記憶にこびりつき、失敗という選択肢がないことを思い出させてくれる。常識に照らせば、成功もまた選択肢にはない。

「上官たちの狂気じみた目的は達成されない――いや、達成などできない。そして権力者どもがようやくその事実を悟った時、自分たちの失敗を私の無能のせいにするだろう。命までは守れぬかもしれないが、正気を保ち、名誉を守るためにも、この記録を残しておく。」

source:
"I was told that the construction at Al-Akia was completed only two years ago, but the pyramid is plainly much older than the other buildings. The Qantari are everywhere, like an infestation of desert worm. I do not like them and I do not trust them. I have made my opinions known to the High Magus, but he is buried in his research and oblivious to everything else.

"Apparently, he cannot generate sufficient Power to enact his mad scheme, which lends me the slight hope that whoever anointed this insufferable ass High Magus will one day find himself removed from his head by a very sharp blade. In any case the High Magus now spends his days scribbling ‘theoretical’ (or ‘nonsensical’, to the layman) geometries and consulting with the Qantari. Imagine an Imperial High Magus sitting down with half-naked savages who paint themselves with blood! Disgrace upon disgrace."
target_ja:
「アル＝アキアの建設が完了したのはわずか二年前だと聞かされたが、ピラミッドだけは明らかにほかの建物よりはるかに古い。カンターリは砂漠の虫が湧くように、そこら中にいる。私は連中が嫌いだし、信用もしていない。そのことは大魔導士にも伝えたが、奴は研究に没頭し、それ以外のことにはまるで目を向けない。

「どうやら、あの狂った計画を実行するのに十分な〈力〉を生み出せないらしい。そのおかげで、この耐え難い阿呆を大魔導士に任じた者が、いつの日か鋭い刃で奴の首を胴から切り離してくれるのではないかと、わずかな希望を抱ける。ともかく、大魔導士は今や日がな一日『理論的な』（素人に言わせれば『意味不明な』）幾何学図形を書き散らし、カンターリと相談している。帝国の大魔導士が、血で体を塗りたくった半裸の野蛮人どもと膝を突き合わせる姿を想像してみろ！　恥の上塗りだ。」

source:
"The High Magus and his imbeciles built have managed to assemble some contraption on top of the pyramid. And without a single one falling to his death, mores the pity. When I asked him what it was, he said the answer would be too much for my fragile mind. I considered that any mind would seem fragile under the blow of a war hammer, but I will save my wit for the report to the Senate.
...

"Predictably, the first two attempts were utter failures, generating not so much as a colored spark. The High Magus walks more quietly now, and speaks softly. He even appears to be avoiding me. I have begun a first draft of my findings for the Senate, but I must be careful not to show how gratified I am by this catastrophe. One more week I will give him, one week to tighten the noose yet further."
target_ja:
「大魔導士とその愚か者どもは、ピラミッドの頂上に何やら装置を組み上げることに成功した。しかも残念なことに、一人も転落死しなかった。それが何なのか尋ねると、私の繊細な頭では理解しきれないだろうと言われた。戦鎚で殴られれば、どんな頭でも繊細になるだろうと思ったが、この機知は元老院への報告書のために取っておくことにする。
...

「予想どおり、最初の二度の試みは完全な失敗だった。色のついた火花一つ出なかった。大魔導士は今では足音まで静かになり、声も小さい。私を避けているようにすら見える。元老院に提出する調査報告書の第一稿を書き始めたが、この惨事を私がどれほど喜んでいるか悟られぬよう注意しなければならない。あと一週間だけ猶予をやろう。自らの首の縄をさらに締めるための一週間だ。」

source:
"It worked! The blasted, thrice-accursed, misbegotten whore of a machine worked. And it would have been my greatest triumph if not for the meddling of those knuckle-dragging primitives! The High Magus told me – me, a Legatus! – to oversee the installation of a ‘fail-safe’ device as if I were some lowly mechanus.

"I delegated the task to the Qantari chief. Our translator, the only man other than the High Magus fluent in their abrasive tongue, had expired from the sting of a desert insect the week before, so that some few details may have been miscommunicated. In any event, the barbarian grinned at me with his filed teeth and assured me that my will would be done."
target_draft:
「動いた！　あの忌々しい、三度呪われた、出来損ないの売女のような機械が動いたのだ。あの拳を地面に引きずる原始人どもの横槍さえなければ、これは私にとって最大の勝利になっていただろう！　大魔導士は私に――このレガトゥスたる私に！――まるで下賤なメカヌスにでも命じるように、『安全装置』の設置を監督しろと言った。

「私はその仕事をカンターリの長に任せた。大魔導士を除けば、耳障りな連中の言葉を流暢に話せる唯一の通訳は、その前の週に砂漠の虫に刺されて死んでいた。そのため、細部に多少の行き違いがあったかもしれない。いずれにせよ、その野蛮人は削った歯を見せて私に笑いかけ、私の望みどおりにすると請け合った。」

source:
"Obviously, the device malfunctioned – truth be told I suspect they all knew it would not work. This drivel about a fail-safe was like as not a ploy to shift the blame to me – and the Power surge turned the three ‘champions’ to charcoal. I thank whatever Gods the Magus is praying to that he wasn’t there to see it.

"I had a few of my personal slaves clean everything up and replaced the erstwhile champions with three soldiers under my command. Take note, dear reader, of the difference between a leader and a talker. I made this project work and when we ran into a problem, I found a solution. And unlike the great and mighty Magi it didn't take me years to do so."
target_ja:
「当然ながら、装置は誤作動した――実を言えば、連中は全員、最初から動かないと知っていたのではないかと思っている。この安全装置とやらの戯言は、おそらく責任を私に押しつけるための策略だったのだ――そして〈力〉の奔流が三人の『勇士』を黒焦げにした。魔導士がその場にいなかったことについては、奴が祈っている神々が何者であれ感謝している。

「私は私有奴隷を何人か使ってすべて片づけさせ、かつて勇士だった三人の代わりに、私の指揮下の兵士を三人据えた。親愛なる読者よ、指導者と口先だけの者との違いをよく覚えておくがいい。この計画を実際に動かしたのは私だ。問題が起きれば、私は解決策を見つけた。しかも偉大にして強大なる魔導士どもとは違い、それに何年もかけたりはしなかった。」

source:
The desk is covered with scrolls: notes, diagrams, endless calculations and obscure formulae. One fragment catches your eye:

"We have modified the engines again. The readings show the output to be stable within the parameters we specified – as safe as one can reasonably expect, given the circumstances. The last obstacle has finally been removed. There’s no reason to delay any longer.

"Iulianus will go first. He shows no fear of what's to come. Like his brethren, he thinks he will be filled with divine essence, become a great warrior. His ambitions, subject to the same limit as his feeble imagination, go no further. We have chosen well."
target_ja:
机の上は巻物で埋め尽くされている。覚え書き、図面、果てしない計算、難解な数式。その中の一片が目に留まる。

「我々は再び機関に改修を施した。測定値によれば、出力は我々が定めた範囲内で安定している。この状況で合理的に望み得る限り、安全と言ってよい。最後の障害はついに取り除かれた。もはや先延ばしにする理由はない。

「最初はユリアヌスが行く。彼はこれから起こることを恐れていない。同胞たちと同じく、自分が神の精髄で満たされ、偉大な戦士になると考えている。貧弱な想像力と同じく、その野心にも限界があり、それ以上のことは望んでいない。我々は良い者を選んだ。」

source:
Another fragment:

"We attempted to power up the wards today. I feared the worst after the initial failure, but they are holding. Tissue swelling and bone loss were expected factors. Not a single ward has collapsed. Yet.

"The bindings give us absolute control over the subjects. Their marvelous abilities, which to the commoner will make them seem as gods, are completely in our control, and their physical forms subject to our will. If the worst comes to pass we may destroy them entirely. Without this tightest of reins I would never have agreed to bring these beings to our plane, no matter the alternative."
target_ja:
別の断片。

「今日、結界の起動を試みた。最初の失敗の後だけに最悪の事態を恐れていたが、結界は持ちこたえている。組織の腫脹と骨量の減少は予想されていた要因だ。崩壊した結界は一つもない。今のところは。

「拘束術によって、被験者を完全に支配できる。庶民の目には神々とさえ映るであろう彼らの驚異的な能力は、完全に我々の制御下にあり、その肉体も我々の意志に従う。最悪の場合には、彼らを完全に破壊することもできる。これほど厳重な手綱がなければ、ほかにどんな選択肢がなかったとしても、私は決してこれらの存在を我々の次元へ招くことには同意しなかっただろう。」

source:
The scroll falls apart in your hands, making it difficult to continue:

"Now that the ritual is complete, I must confess that the deepest part of me had not believed it possible until this moment. Only a few years ago we were as blind as mole rats, ignorant of the different planes, of the higher life forms, of so many possibilities. Today, we bound the very gods to our plane and our will, acting not as their servants but as their masters. Without a doubt, this is the hour of our greatest triumph!"
target_ja:

source:
Another fragment:

"The knowledge is overwhelming, the power unspeakable. Every day I – First of the Magi, wisest amongst my brothers – learn more from our gods than what I had gleaned from decades of study. I am forced to reconsider my opinion of the Qantari. So far, every word they’ve told us has been the truth.

"The barbarians have been foolish in their generosity. They have shared their knowledge without restraint, showed us the key to communicating with their gods. They needed our cooperation to bring them here, but to gain it they bartered away everything."
target_ja:
別の断片。

「その知識は圧倒的で、その力は言葉では言い表せない。筆頭魔導士にして、同胞の中で最も賢きこの私でさえ、数十年の研究で得た以上のものを、日々我らの神々から学んでいる。カンターリに対する見方を改めざるを得ない。これまでのところ、彼らが我々に語ったことはすべて真実だった。

「野蛮人どもは愚かにも惜しみなく与えすぎた。知識を何の制限もなく分け与え、彼らの神々と交信するための鍵まで我々に示した。神々をここへ連れてくるには我々の協力が必要だった。その協力を得るために、彼らはすべてを差し出してしまったのだ。」

source:
"I noticed the first change, subtle yet alarming, today. The one we call Xenorath – a fitting name, resembling the coughing sound it made to name itself – has developed a fondness for swimming. The ocean reminds him of the endless void of his native plane.

"Today he spent hours underwater in the darkness. He described a hideous creature he discovered on the sea bottom, though if he had gone that deep the pressure should have crushed its human form like a bug. The bastard did something to his fleshly vessel, altered it somehow, without anyone noticing. If he is able to make changes to his own form, what else he can do? What else can *they* do? Have we been too arrogant in our belief that we can control them? We shall find out tomorrow."
target_ja:
「今日、最初の変化に気づいた。微妙ではあるが、憂慮すべき変化だ。我々がゼノラスと呼ぶ者――自ら名乗った時の咳き込むような音によく似た、実にふさわしい名だ――が、泳ぐことを好むようになった。海は、彼の故郷である次元の果てしない虚無を思い起こさせるらしい。

「今日、彼は暗い海中で何時間も過ごした。海底で見つけたという醜悪な生物について語ったが、本当にそこまで深く潜ったのなら、水圧で人間の肉体など虫のように押し潰されていたはずだ。あの忌々しい奴は、誰にも気づかれずに自らの肉体の器へ何かを施し、何らかの形で変化させたのだ。自分の姿を変えられるのなら、ほかに何ができる？　*奴ら*には、ほかに何ができるのだ？　我々は彼らを支配できると信じ、思い上がりすぎていたのか？　明日になれば分かる。」

source:
Much of the scroll is damaged so you can only make out the ending:

"I am not ashamed to say that I have wept this last hour, wept with despair. How could I have been so blind? The Qantari lied. Their scraping and servile manner, the painted faces, filed teeth and savage rituals were all a ruse, and the worst humiliation of all is that we still don't understand everything that happened. No matter... There are three gods yet on our side. The humanity has bled from them day by day like water through a sieve, until soon I think we will not recognize them as men at all. No matter. I will not quibble over their looks now that everything we have is at stake. The die is cast.

"If this humble manuscript survives the holocaust that is to come, and any on two legs chances to read it, I can only assume that we have won."
target_ja:

target_ja: メルが石棺に入るのを手伝う。中では重い金属製の拘束具が、彼の両腕と両脚を固定するのを待っている。可動式の支持具に取り付けられた奇妙な形の兜を下ろし、彼の頭を包み込む位置まで動かす。一歩下がると、メルがつぶやく祈りの声の中、二つに分かれた蓋がひとりでに閉じる。

source: The loremaster begins reciting an unknown mantra. Gradually, a previously unnoticed hum burgeons to an oppressive drone. The noise emanates from the pyramid, continuing to grow as the chamber lights up, awakening from its centuries-long slumber. Meru’s voice within the metal shell grows in volume alongside the humming racket, turning ragged and halting. He’s practically screaming his supplications now.
target_ja: 伝承学者が未知の祈りの文句を唱え始める。やがて、それまで気づかなかった低い唸りが、圧迫するような轟音へと膨れ上がる。音はピラミッドから発せられ、部屋に明かりが灯って数世紀にわたる眠りから目覚めるにつれ、ますます大きくなる。金属の殻の中から聞こえるメルの声も轟音とともに大きくなり、かすれて途切れ途切れになる。今や彼は、ほとんど絶叫するように祈願の言葉を叫んでいる。

source:
Time after time the loremaster moves his fingers over the controls. The console lights flicker in reaction, but without the desired result, and the structure around you begins to vibrate from stresses it wasn’t built to withstand. You hear other, more alarming sounds from below, of blocks shifting and mortar crumbling, and you imagine the entire complex collapsing, burying all of you in a tomb never to be uncovered again.

The loremaster tries again and the pyramid finally complies with his request. With a sharp crack, the top splits along its four seams and peels open like a flower, revealing an enormous, crimson crystal, engraved with a thousand arcane symbols.
target_ja:
伝承学者は何度も制御装置の上で指を動かす。操作盤の明かりは反応してちらつくが、望んだ結果は得られない。やがて周囲の構造物が、想定されていない負荷を受けて振動し始める。下からはさらに不穏な音――石材がずれ、モルタルが崩れる音――が聞こえ、施設全体が崩壊して全員が埋まり、二度と暴かれることのない墓になる光景が頭に浮かぶ。

伝承学者がもう一度試みると、ついにピラミッドが要求に応じる。鋭い亀裂音とともに頂部が四本の継ぎ目に沿って割れ、花のように開いていく。その中から現れたのは、無数の秘術の記号が刻まれた巨大な深紅の結晶だった。

source:
Slowly, the loremaster shifts the sliding mechanism which feeds power into the crystal. The vibrations increase until your teeth rattle. It absorbs more and more energy, and still demands more. You half expect it to shatter but it moves not at all. At last the power is at maximum, the indicator the same red as the artifact. The air grows charged and humid. Every hair on your body stands, quivers, and the world itself seems to wait with you.

You are driven to the floor when the first lightning bolt strikes the apex of the crystal, and scramble backwards when it is followed by another. Black ink pools in the white clouds overhead to herald a storm vast and unnatural, overwhelming the sky above. You cover your scorched face as the lightning strikes continue, and intensify. Wind moans hollowly through pillars and fallen walls as clouds begin to swirl slowly around the pyramid.
target_ja:
伝承学者は、結晶へ力を送り込むスライド式の機構をゆっくり動かす。振動は歯が鳴るほどに強くなる。結晶はますます多くのエネルギーを吸収し、それでもなお足りないとばかりに求め続ける。砕け散るのではないかと思うが、びくともしない。ついに出力が最大に達し、表示器はその遺物と同じ赤色になる。空気は帯電し、湿り気を帯びる。全身の毛が逆立って震え、世界そのものがあなたとともに待ち構えているように感じられる。

最初の稲妻が結晶の頂点を直撃すると、あなたは床へ叩きつけられる。続けてもう一条が落ち、慌てて後ずさる。頭上の白い雲には黒い墨を垂らしたような闇が広がり、巨大で不自然な嵐の到来を告げながら空を覆い尽くしていく。稲妻が立て続けに落ち、その激しさを増す中、焼けついた顔をかばう。雲がピラミッドを中心にゆっくり渦巻き始め、風が柱や崩れた壁の間を虚ろな音を立てて吹き抜ける。

source:
[lore success]You recall an account from ancient times of a Qantari tribute to the Emperor. The tribute was a rare crystal, pure and clear as spring water. It was described as being huge, though you hadn’t guessed it was as big as a house. As the story goes, their craftsmen worked on it for decades, until every facet hosted a mysterious symbol, each somehow related to its brother to form a network of powerful magic.

When the engravers’ work was finished, the sacrifices began. Slaves, refugees and criminals were brought in their hundreds to a hideous machine where they were suspended upside-down and their blood decanted over the artifact. Yet however much blood was spilled, the crystal absorbed it all, and over the course of weeks its color changed from pale moonlight to a rich crimson.
target_ja:
[lore success]古代、カンターリが皇帝へ献上した品についての記録を思い出す。献上品は、湧き水のように純粋で透明な希少な結晶だった。巨大だったと記されていたが、まさか家ほどの大きさだとは思っていなかった。話によれば、彼らの職人は数十年をかけて加工し、ついにはすべての面に神秘的な記号が刻まれた。それぞれが互いに結びつき、強大な魔術の網を形成していたという。

彫刻師たちの仕事が終わると、次は生贄が始まった。奴隷、難民、犯罪者が何百人もおぞましい機械へ連れてこられ、逆さ吊りにされ、その血が遺物の上へ注がれた。どれほど血が流されても結晶はすべて吸収し、数週間をかけて淡い月光のような色から濃い深紅へと変わっていった。

source:
Thunder claps deafeningly close. You look up, thinking the crystal must have shattered, but no, it glows with a fierce red health that reminds you, too much, of flesh. At that very moment the crystal releases its energy, firing a ray of impossibly white light into the sky.

The beam vanishes beyond the clouds, to a place you suspect no man could see. You rise to your feet, mesmerized, as the beam begins to pulse, a thaumaturgical bridge between the worlds. When it abruptly vanishes, the engines wind down of their own accord, the deafening drone softens and ceases, and the silence which ruled for many lifetimes of men rushes jealously back to claim the chamber. You are allowed a merciful few moments to gather your thoughts. Then the doors of the sarcophagus open. A man exits the device much more assuredly than Meru went in. He is pale but still, calm.
target_ja:
耳をつんざく雷鳴がすぐ近くで轟く。結晶が砕けたに違いないと思って見上げるが、そうではない。それは肉を思わせるほど生々しく、力強い赤い輝きを放っている。その瞬間、結晶が蓄えたエネルギーを解き放ち、あり得ないほど白い光線を空へ撃ち上げる。

光線は雲の向こう、人の目では決して見通せないと思える場所へ消えていく。呆然と見つめながら立ち上がると、光線が脈動し始める。二つの世界を結ぶ魔術の橋だ。やがてそれが突然消えると、機関はひとりでに停止していき、耳をつんざく轟音も弱まって消える。そして幾世代もの人間の生涯にわたってこの場所を支配していた静寂が、嫉妬深く部屋を取り戻すように押し寄せる。ありがたいことに、考えをまとめるためのわずかな時間が与えられる。やがて石棺の扉が開く。メルが入った時とは比べものにならないほど確かな足取りで、一人の男が装置から出てくる。顔は青白いが、動じる様子はなく、静かだ。

source:
You are looking at the form of a man, of what was Meru. Now it is no longer Meru, nor is it a man.

“Kneel,” it says, without actually looking in your direction. The words are gentle. The power behind them is the sort that does not require threats.
target_ja:
目の前にいるのは人の姿をしたもの――かつてメルだったものだ。だが今や、それはもはやメルではなく、人間ですらない。

「ひざまずけ」それはこちらを見ることさえなく言う。言葉は穏やかだ。その背後にある力には、脅しなど必要ない。
speaker: Meru

target_ja: 弱っているうちに殺す。
speaker: Meru

source:
Drawing your weapon, you step forward. Fake-Meru smiles disdainfully, moving with speed he didn't possess before.

Faelan looks at fake-Meru in confusion, waiting for an order. As he locks his eyes with fake-Meru's pit-black eyes, he cries out, grasping his head, then collapses, convulsing on the floor.
target_ja:
武器を抜き、前へ踏み出す。偽のメルは蔑むように笑い、以前の彼にはなかった速さで動く。

フェイランは困惑した様子で偽のメルを見つめ、命令を待っている。偽のメルの底なしの黒い瞳と目が合った瞬間、フェイランは頭を抱えて叫び声を上げ、その場に倒れ込んで床の上で痙攣する。

source:
Fake-Meru pauses a moment to consider the sky, the sarcophagus, and finally you. Too late you sense the significance of kneeling before this being. There is a presence behind your eyes, a compulsion to obey which you might be able to overcome if you turned all your will against it. Or not.

“You have questions.” Thankfully, the pressure relents. The deity is pleased with you. What would happen were it displeased does not merit further thought.
target_ja:
偽のメルはしばし立ち止まり、空を、石棺を、そして最後にあなたを見る。この存在の前にひざまずくことが何を意味するのか、気づいた時には遅すぎた。目の奥に何者かの存在を感じる。服従を強いる力だ。全意志をもって抗えば打ち破れるかもしれない。あるいは、無理かもしれない。

「質問があるのだな」ありがたいことに、圧力が和らぐ。神はあなたを気に入っている。不興を買った時に何が起こるかなど、考えない方がいい。
speaker: Meru

source: “Your kind named me Balzaar. Since you must have a signifier to fix this entity in the feeble hierarchy of your brain, it will suffice.”
target_ja: 「お前たちの種族は我をバルザールと名づけた。脆弱な脳の階層構造の中にこの存在を位置づけるには記号が必要なのだろう。それで十分だ」
speaker: Balzaar

source: “Gone,” it says simply. You reflect that Meru achieved exactly what he desired. The god is silent. You are allowed more questions.
target_ja: 「消えた」それはただそう言う。メルはまさに自ら望んだものを得たのだ、とあなたは思う。神は沈黙している。さらに質問することを許されている。
speaker: Balzaar

source: “We return to Ganezzar. The siege will be dissolved and you will go to the temple of Agathoth.”
target_draft: 「ガネザールへ戻る。包囲は解かれる。そしてお前はアガトスの神殿へ行け」
speaker: Balzaar

source: “We return to Ganezzar. I will finish what Meru started and you will go to the temple of Agathoth.”
target_draft: 「ガネザールへ戻る。我はメルが始めたことを終わらせる。そしてお前はアガトスの神殿へ行け」
speaker: Balzaar

source: “Agathoth is a threat. He will be destroyed.” As with all of his pronouncements, it is a fact beyond dispute.
target_draft: 「アガトスは脅威だ。滅ぼす」ほかの宣告と同じく、それは議論の余地のない事実として告げられる。
speaker: Balzaar

source: “Help me understand, master. Can Agathoth be more powerful than you?”
target_draft: 「お教えください、我が主。アガトスはあなたより強大なのですか？」
speaker: Balzaar

source:
“When the Magi severed the link, Agathoth shielded his vessel of flesh somehow. He alone did not return to the void. Yet he did not manifest his presence in this world either. The vessel is most probably damaged beyond recovery, but I do not leave such details to chance.

“I begin the work of rehabilitating my own vessel, and in time will regenerate my abilities. This form is far along in its naturally short span, and weak from neglect besides, much weaker than the first vessel. It will be a lengthy process. During this time you will act as my agent.”
target_draft:
「魔導士が繋がりを断った時、アガトスは何らかの方法で自らの肉の器を守った。虚無へ戻らなかったのは奴だけだ。だが、この世界にその存在を顕現させることもなかった。器はおそらく修復不能なほど損傷している。だが我は、そのような細部を偶然に委ねはしない。

「我は自らの器の修復を始め、やがて能力を再生する。この肉体は本来短い寿命のかなり先まで進んでおり、放置されていたため弱ってもいる。最初の器よりはるかに脆弱だ。長い過程になる。その間、お前は我が代理人として働け」
speaker: Balzaar

source: “Why did you choose this body if it is so weak?”
target_ja: 「それほど弱いのなら、なぜこの肉体を選んだのですか？」
speaker: Balzaar

source: “Others recognize it, and are accustomed to its authority. It will be more efficient to begin with this one than to utilize an unfamiliar form to enslave them.”
target_ja: 「他の者たちはこの肉体を知っており、その権威にも慣れている。見知らぬ姿を使って彼らを隷属させるより、これを使って始める方が効率的だ」
speaker: Balzaar

source:
Faelan kneels next to him, checking the vitals, then gets up.

“He was a man of faith to the end,” says Faelan. For the first time he isn't smiling. “I'll stay with him for a while.”
target_ja:
フェイランは彼のそばにひざまずいて生体反応を確かめ、それから立ち上がる。

「最後まで信仰の人だった」フェイランは言う。彼が笑っていないのは初めてだ。「しばらくここに残るよ」
speaker: Faelan

source:
The entity that was once Lord Meru lies dead at your feet. Faelan approaches unsteadily, bleeding from his nose and ears.

“I touched his mind,” he says slowly, as if he has difficulty speaking. “It was...,” he searches for words then gives up. “It wasn’t him.”
target_ja:
かつてメル卿だった存在が、あなたの足元で死んでいる。フェイランが鼻と耳から血を流しながら、よろめくように近づいてくる。

「奴の精神に触れた」話すことすら難しいかのように、彼はゆっくりと言う。「あれは……」言葉を探すが、やがて諦める。「メルじゃなかった」
speaker: Faelan

source: “We have to burn the body. We have to be *sure*,” he says, almost pleadingly.
target_ja: 「死体を焼かないと。*確実に*しておかないと」フェイランは懇願するように言う。
speaker: Faelan

Meru's men cluster around the pyramid as if they wish to throw themselves upon it, but instead begin to whisk the sand from its markings with little horsehair brushes. In contrast to their vocal exchanges over the last week, they now speak in excited whispers. "Taller than any human, with glowing eyes and sharp claws, they came from the depth of the underworld and attacked without warning, slaughtering men and women alike. We fought the devils tooth and nail, but when the victory was at hand, they called forth their gods. Can you imagine a living horror towering over a battlefield and sweeping it with its arms, tearing flesh and armor with its talons? Our only chance was to reach into the higher planes and summon allies who could help us even the odds.

"Eventually the call was answered and the allies came. They burned the Qantari and their gods, leaving nothing but ashes. They saved us, but it was too late. The Empire had fallen, for too much had been destroyed. Saddened, our allies, the lords of the higher planes, left us to rebuild and restore, but as you can see, we are still living in our crumbling towns, still fighting each other like savages."

「やがて呼びかけに応え、味方が現れた。奴らはカンターリとその神々を焼き払い、灰すら残さなかった。我々は救われた。だが、遅すぎた。あまりに多くが破壊され、帝国は崩壊していた。悲しみに暮れた我らの味方、高次の領域の諸侯は、再建と復興を我々に託して去った。だが見てのとおり、我々はいまだ崩れかけた町に住み、野蛮人のように互いを争っている」

source:
"Do I look like a loremaster to you? The guild goes back centuries. Well, at least the name does. From what I've been told, things were different in the olden days – roads paved with gold, rivers full of milk and honey, but if you ask me, it was probably the same shit.

"Some men aren't made for 'honest' work, if by honest you mean slaving away for a pittance. It comes at a price though," he waves around, indicating the tavern, but doesn't elaborate.

「俺が伝承学者に見えるか？　ギルドは何世紀も続いてる。まあ、少なくとも名前だけはな。聞いた話じゃ、昔は何もかも違ってたそうだ――道は黄金で舗装され、川には乳と蜜が流れてたとか。だが俺に言わせりゃ、たぶん今と同じクソみたいなもんだったさ。

「『真っ当な』仕事に向いてない奴もいる。真っ当ってのが、はした金のために奴隷みたいに働くことを言うならな。ただし、その代償はある」彼は酒場を示すように手を振るが、それ以上は説明しない。
speaker: Aziz

target_ja: 「俺たちは堂々と活動してるが……」
speaker: Aziz

source: "We always do. You can hide all you want, but any guard worth his salt knows where to find those who break the laws in his town. It's rarely worth the trouble though. Besides, why kill the goose that lays the golden eggs? I daresay we pay more in bribes than the rest of the town pays in taxes and levies."
target_ja: 「いつだってそうだ。いくら隠れたところで、まともな衛兵なら自分の町で法を破る連中がどこにいるかくらい知ってる。だが、わざわざ手を出すほどのことは滅多にない。それに、金の卵を産むガチョウを殺してどうする？　俺たちが払う賄賂は、町の他の連中が払う税金や徴収金を合わせた額より多いくらいだ。」
speaker: Aziz

source: "Didn't stop them from nailing Cado's predecessor to the front door, did it?"
target_ja: 「だからって、カドの前任者が玄関の扉に釘付けにされるのは防げなかっただろ？」
speaker: Aziz

source:
"Tullius? I was surprised he lasted that long. He was a good and well respected thief, but power clouded his judgement and made him see things that weren't there. He thought that the guards were working for him because he was paying them more. He thought that he was running the town.

"In the end Dellar had to pay Tullius a visit and show everyone the error of his way. Then he had a long chat with Cado and we got us a new guildmaster."
target_ja:
「トゥリウスか？　あいつがあそこまで長く持ったことの方が驚きだ。腕もよく、尊敬もされていた盗賊だったが、権力で判断が曇り、ありもしないものが見えるようになった。衛兵に多く払っているから、自分のために働いていると思い込んだ。町を仕切っているつもりになったんだ。

「結局、デラーがトゥリウスを訪ねて、そのやり方が間違いだったことを皆に思い知らせた。それからカドとじっくり話をして、新しいギルド長が決まった。」
speaker: Aziz

source: "What can you tell me about the guild's history?"
target_ja: 「ギルドの歴史について何か知っているか？」
speaker: Aziz

source: "I help people make right decisions. Break their heads if they don't. In most cases this is all the motivation they need."
target_ja: 「俺は人が正しい決断をするのを手伝う。しないなら頭をかち割る。たいていは、それだけで十分やる気になってくれる。」

target_ja: 「俺たちは主に物を盗むんじゃなかったのか？」

source:
"Any idiot can swipe something. It takes more than that to run a successful guild. We sell what we can, what can't be traced back to us, and we send the rest to other towns with caravans. I've lost count how many times people have tried to fuck us.

「物をかっぱらうだけなら馬鹿でもできる。うまくギルドを回すには、それ以上が必要だ。売れる物、足がつかない物は売る。残りは隊商に載せて別の町へ送る。俺たちを出し抜こうとした奴が何人いたか、もう数えるのもやめた。

source:
You stand in the hall of Antidas, signs of wealth and power all around you. Wherever you look you see exotic tapestries and paintings, rare vases, gleaming statues. Ornate pillars run the length of the hall, all the way to the throne itself, where Lord Antidas is sitting in front of his audience, a group of petitioners seeking his aid and favour. Soldiers of the House stand guard, ready to shield Antidas and turn the hall into a slaughterhouse at the first sign of trouble.

You wait for your turn and then approach. Lord Antidas gestures and a man steps from behind the throne. It's your old friend Cassius, smiling triumphantly.

"You dare to plot against me!" explodes Antidas, barely controlling his rage. "Dellar! Throw <him/her> out of my town!"

Forty two year old loremaster Cassius, contemptuously called 'young Cassius' by his gray haired colleagues, has never understood the appeal of digging through dirt and ruins like a rat. Instead, he preferred to spend his time among neatly preserved scrolls, studying the work of many prominent loremasters of the antiquity and hundreds of accompanying commentaries he considered indispensable. Master Cassius was working on his second tractate, analyzing manifestations of the divine will in year 4052, when Antidas' emissaries invited him to Teron.

source: "Very well. All weapon metals are what's called aleiers - several substances forged together in such a manner that they become a new substance. Bronze, for example, is an aleier of copper and tin. Iron is an aleier of iron ore and charcoal. Steel is iron without impurities. To remove impurities, you must add limestone or glass. They will float to the surface and attract all impurities. Blue steel is an aleier of steel and kobald ore, which is what gives it the blue hue. And finally, the sky metal is an aleier of iron and several rare metals. The trick, as I understand it, is not the rarity of the metals though, but the extreme cold of the void and the heat of the fall."
target_ja: 「よかろう。武器に使われる金属はすべて、“合成金属”と呼ばれるものだ。複数の物質を一つの新たな物質になるよう鍛え合わせたものだ。たとえば青銅は銅と錫の合成金属。鉄は鉄鉱石と木炭の合成金属だ。鋼は不純物を取り除いた鉄だ。不純物を除くには石灰岩かガラスを加える。それらは表面へ浮き、不純物をすべて引き寄せる。青鋼は鋼とコバルト鉱の合成金属で、それが青い色を生む。そして最後に、星鉄は鉄と数種の希少金属の合成金属だ。だが私の理解では、要となるのは金属の希少さではなく、虚空の極寒と落下時の熱だ」

source:
You step closer to Cassius and let him see you for what you are – a remorseless killer. You look at him until you can feel his fear, until Cassius understands how close he came to dying and that no money in the world is worth decades of his unlived life. Then you start talking.

That if you can get away, get to your people, they can protect you. Everyone thinks that. Right up to the end, when they're looking up at me, choking on their own blood, they still think someone's going to come and save them. But no one does. source:
"It started a couple of weeks ago. We saw people leaving the city, just marching straight out into the wasteland, and not on the road but due north. They carried nothing with them but the clothes on their backs.

"The guards laughed at first. If a bunch of nobodies decided to take the desert air with the raiders and scorpions, and gods only know what else, good luck to them. It was good sport betting on how long a drover or a seamstress would survive with no weapons, no gear, not even a canteen.

"But then entire families began to leave, again with no baggage, no carts. With evening coming down, we finally decided to stop and question them. Their faces looked wrong to me, slack, and their eyes dull as if they'd been drugged. Every man and woman claimed they had heard a Call, just those words. "Something is written at the bottom in the glyph language. The Eye of Thor-Agoth will show you the way," he reads slowly. "The Eye of Thor-Agoth..." whispers Feng, looking at you with widened eyes. The center of the crystal is completely black, giving it the appearance of an eye.

"I found it a long time ago in the ruins west from here. It was shining softly and warm to the touch. That's how the gem will guide you – it will glow brighter and brighter the closer you get. source:
Finally, something interesting. It’s an interpretation of a document written from the words of a blind magus. The document itself is missing, but it seems the magus attempted to explain how the ‘shadowy gates’ worked to a scribe assigned to him in his last days. The scribe dutifully wrote everything down and passed to his superiors for evaluation. The document gathered dust for almost two hundred years until it was discovered by an eager but overly verbose loremaster who attempted to ‘make sense of the arcane’.

The interpretation leaves much to be desired but the cited passages speak of a honeycomb network and a complex system that governed it. Once activated, a gate stayed connected to the entire network but in order to transmute matter – the scribe noted that the magus said what sounded like ‘transmit’ – it required a special permission, granted or revoked by the First of the Magi’s Officium.

source:
Faelan the Thrice Blessed owed everything he had - including his life - to Lord Meru who saved him from the gallows. Born a slave, Faelan made his life a lot harder by refusing to keep his eyes down. He was always staring at people, staring with such intensity that it made even hardened Imperial Guardsmen uncomfortable. It was that staring as much as his refusal to work that earned him the beatings. When the Guardsmen had finally had enough of his resistance and came to make an example of him, witnesses say he did nothing to defend himself. He simply stared at the soldiers, and smiled that twisted smile. And, one by one, they took out their daggers and slit their own throats.

Terrifying though this display of power was, the Imperial Guards were veterans of many battles. Quickly recovering from their shock, the remaining Guards overwhelmed Faelan with their numbers, beating him unconscious. His execution would have followed swiftly if word of his deed hadn't reached the ears of Lord Meru. And so Faelan the slave became Faelan the Thrice Blessed, the Magus of House Crassus, a position of near unlimited wealth and influence.

They're waiting, waiting for you to be at peace, waiting for you to join them.

source:
Paullus’ men approach the Aurelians in close formation and their new allies greet them with cheers, as what seemed a hopeless slog suddenly has the look of a triumph. You alone, knowing what is to come, recognize the tension in the approaching soldiers. Nowhere do you see a smile or a friendly wave, or an iota of slackened discipline.

In grim silence, Paullus’ highest officer and bodyguards step into the Aurelian command tent, and moments later the charade ends in blood.

With no more emotion than a butcher rendering a calf, the interlopers fall on their victims without mercy. By the time the defenders manage to assemble a formation, half of their men have been incapacitated or slain. In the instant when it appears that the Aurelians may in spite of everything rally, the sound of a distant gong signals the opening of Ganezzar’s main gates. Crassus’ troops push forward in a wave, driving the remaining Aurelian forces ahead of them into the hills.

The siege is broken.
target_draft:
パウルスの兵は密集隊形のままアウレリアン軍へ近づく。新たな同盟軍の到着に歓声が上がり、絶望的に見えた長期戦が一転して勝利の様相を帯びる。だが、これから何が起こるか知っているあなただけは、近づく兵士たちの緊張を見抜いている。笑顔も、友好的に手を振る者も、一瞬たりとも規律を緩める気配もない。

重苦しい沈黙の中、パウルス配下の最高位の将校と護衛がアウレリアン軍の指揮天幕へ入る。そして数瞬後、その芝居は血の中で終わる。

仔牛を解体する肉屋ほどの感情も見せず、闖入者たちは容赦なく犠牲者へ襲いかかる。守備兵が隊形を整える頃には、兵の半数が戦闘不能か死亡していた。それでもアウレリアン軍が立て直すかに見えた瞬間、遠くの鐘が鳴り、ガネザールの正門が開く。クラッスス軍が波のように押し出し、残るアウレリアン軍を丘陵へ追い立てる。

包囲は破られた。
パウルスを追って城へ入る。

source:
Carrinas’ legionaries keep up the charade until the very last moment. The Aurelian soldiers, believing them to be the vanguard of the army, respond with cheers, but their enthusiasm turns to ragged shouts of warning as the Imperial Guards level their weapons and charge. Like a spear through a paper screen, the Imperial Guards burst through the defenders’ ranks to overrun the command tent.

In that same moment, the sound of a distant gong signals the opening of Ganezzar’s main gates and Crassus’ troops spill out, adding to chaos and confusion. By the time the Aurelians manage to assemble a defensive line, half of their men have been incapacitated or slain and soon the remainder are broken. Although few of Carrinas’ legionaries are still standing and the bodies of Meru’s zealots litter the ground, their sacrifice hasn’t been in vain. The Aurelian forces are devastated, and with no prospect of reinforcements they are compelled to withdraw.

Crassus’ legatus, oblivious to the blood covering the left side of his face and running down his neck, does not look to you but simply nods once, satisfied.

The siege is broken.
target_draft:
カリナスの軍団兵たちは最後の瞬間まで芝居を続ける。アウレリアン兵は彼らを軍の先鋒だと思い歓声を上げるが、帝国衛兵団が武器を構えて突撃すると、その歓声はばらばらの警告の叫びへ変わる。紙の衝立を槍で突き破るように、帝国衛兵団は守備隊の隊列を突破し、指揮天幕へなだれ込む。

同時に遠くの鐘が鳴り、ガネザールの正門が開く。クラッスス軍が溢れ出し、混乱はさらに広がる。アウレリアン軍が防衛線を整える頃には、兵の半数が戦闘不能か死亡し、ほどなく残りも崩れる。カリナスの軍団兵はほとんど立っておらず、メルの狂信者たちの死体が地面を覆うが、その犠牲は無駄ではなかった。アウレリアン軍は壊滅的打撃を受け、援軍の見込みもないまま撤退を余儀なくされる。

クラッスス側の軍団長は、顔の左半分を覆い首筋へ流れる血にも気づいていないようで、あなたを見ることもなく、満足げに一度だけうなずく。

包囲は破られた。
カリナスを追って城へ入る。

source:
In the hour before dawn, the Sellsword Legion rises from the hills like shadows silently come to life. The Aurelian watchmen must at some point have grown lazy, for no alarm sounds as the mercenaries raise their voices in a single terrifying shriek and rush the besiegers’ camp from all sides. Chaos ensues, with bitter curses, the clashing of blades, and ripping of canvas punctuated by the deep thump of bombs detonating, killing men from both sides. The mercenaries are wild-eyed from ingesting mushrooms, or simply bloodlust, and counter the discipline of their foes with a reckless disregard for their own lives.

When it becomes clear that the sellswords are killing at least as many as they are losing, Ganezzar’s main gates yawn wide, Crassus’ troops pour out, and confusion becomes havoc. By the time the Aurelians manage to assemble a defensive line, half of their men have been incapacitated or slain and soon the remainder are broken. The corpses of the sellswords and Meru’s zealots lay thick on the ground, but their sacrifice hasn’t been in vain. Though they dealt as much death as anyone could expect, the Aurelian forces are devastated, and with no prospect of reinforcements they are compelled to withdraw.

As you regard this grim shambles, one of the mercenaries is still whooping and leaping about, thrusting his spear at invisible enemies, until at the end of one particularly wild stagger he falls full on the blade of a sword, wedged point upward between two corpses.

The siege is broken.
target_draft:

傭兵たちが失う以上の敵を確実に倒していると分かると、ガネザールの正門が大きく開き、クラッスス軍がなだれ出る。混乱は大混乱へ変わる。アウレリアン軍が防衛線を整える頃には兵の半数が戦闘不能か死亡し、ほどなく残りも崩れる。傭兵とメルの狂信者の死体が地面を厚く覆うが、その犠牲は無駄ではない。期待できる限りの損害を与え、アウレリアン軍は壊滅し、援軍の見込みもないため撤退を余儀なくされる。

この惨状を眺めていると、傭兵の一人がまだ叫びながら跳ね回り、見えない敵へ槍を突き出している。やがてひどくよろめいた拍子に、二つの死体の間で刃を上向きに挟まれていた剣へ、そのまま倒れ込む。

包囲は破られた。

You step out of the tent and into the chaos of battle.

The siege is broken.

“They would have killed women and children without pity for the crime of having faith in something greater than petty squabbles, for the sin of having hope. But the Gods, the Gods would have none of that and their will cannot – ever – be denied.”

In the instant when it appears that the Aurelians may in spite of everything rally, the sound of a distant gong signals the opening of Ganezzar’s main gates. source:
“Darius... he had much promise,” says a voice in your head. The voice rings like a bell in the back of your mind, each word sending painful vibrations throughout your body.

“He was strong and eager, yet even with an army at his back he failed to enter Ganezzar. Failed to reach this chamber. Failed to serve me.” The strident voice is in fact your own, your aching jaw opening and closing as your mouth channels the thoughts of the outside entity.

There is a warrior standing in front of an army. Despite having never seen him before, you know who he is, and you feel his eagerness to serve you. His desire to take Ganezzar radiates from him, need that is driving him mad. Then he is lying dead in his tent, fires burning unchecked nearby, his army broken and scattered. You are enraged at the man. He has failed you.

The voice returns. “You are weak,” it says, “feebleminded, alone. Yet here you are.”

source:
“Athazor’s will is strong.” The words ring in your mind, the vibrations seeming to bounce from the inside of your skull. After a moment of silence, a terrifying vision rears before you, a humongous being resembling an octopus or jellyfish – a dome-like head with a multitude of constantly shifting, probing appendages. Where these tentacles trail, reality alters in their wake. Is this the entity the Magi called Athazor?

“I can sense Athazor’s gift in you, protecting your feeble brain. Without it, my attempt to connect our minds would drive you mad.” The strident voice is in fact your own, your aching jaw opening and closing as your mouth channels the thoughts of the outside entity.

Mercifully, the creature fades from view and the perspective changes. You are looking down at a brighter square in the darkness of the void – the room you’re in now. As if riffling through the pages of a thick tome, you see a series of people sitting in that selfsame chair, all reaching out to the entity, each of them killed outright or driven to gibbering insanity. When the last of these have been destroyed you see yourself, and understand that you are as an insect, too small, usually, even to be noticed, too low to be contemptible.

“You are weak,” the voice says, “feebleminded, alone. Yet here you are.”

Upon reaching their destinations, the lights blink three times, then disappear as the portals fail to respond. One by one the stars and the portals vanish. With the sequence ended, only three remain. One is represented by a ziggurat, the other a tower, and the last one a facility high in the mountains.

source:
At first glance it appears to be a kind of hideous shrine or statue, a metal spider rearing up on its back legs. But taking a few steps forward you see it's a machine, a mechanical construct straight out of some sorcerer's nightmare. The top half is humanoid, with arms ending in blades, and not the kind used for chopping vegetables. This upper part is perched on four spike-tipped legs, any one of them long enough to run a man through.

Its once polished surface is scarred and dented, the armor rent in several places, and it sits somewhat askew. The construct is a veteran of many battles.

The head pivots ever so slightly in your direction. It sees you, but makes no move towards the doorway.

かつて磨き上げられていた表面は傷とへこみだらけで、装甲も数か所裂け、全体が少し傾いている。幾多の戦いをくぐり抜けた機械人形だ。

source:
[lore success]You pull out the nullifier and look at the dial. Suddenly, a distant memory surfaces in your mind – a drawing from an old tractate written by a demented monk. The monk claimed to be an authority on the Old World’s charms and wards, but his tractate was filled with bizarre images that defied all attempts to understand or decipher them.

The drawing in question depicted nightmarish creatures gathering around a magus who was protected by a sun shining down upon him. Instead of the traditional face, the sun had the exact same markings as the dial on the nullifier.

You look at the construct – no reaction. Reluctant to march toward it hoping for the best, you put the device on the marble floor and slide it toward the construct. It stops less than a foot away from it and remains there, doing nothing.

You curse the monk and his drawing and at that very moment the construct folds its limbs and collapses on top of the nullifier.

source:
The zealot nods, murmuring prayers under his breath, his eyes locked on the construct standing between him and the Gods' favor. He takes a step forward, then another, then leaps forward, bringing his axe down.

Unfazed, the constructs attacks, his blades moving faster and faster. Within moments the zealot is bleeding from a dozen shallow wounds but his faith shields him from pain. Shouting like a madman, he presses forward, hacking at the construct as if it were a tree. One leg gives in, the construct's blades flash one last time, and both the man and the machine go down for good.

You enter the palace district, your senses assaulted by the sights and sounds of the sea of humanity around you. Everywhere, people shout and jostle for position - haughty nobles and their routines and guards, guild masters giving orders to scurrying clerks, emissaries from distant lands seeking an audience, servants of the Great Houses on urgent errands, citizens seeking ruling on disputes and tattered petitioners come to beg for aid. In the distance you see the palace itself – a multi-dome structure surrounded by tall minarets. Legend has it that the minarets somehow protected the palace from attacks, during the war. But there is no defence against betrayal; one of the minarets was brought down from within by a traitor. You can see where it collapsed, caving in one of the domes as it fell. There is a slight shimmering in the air around the minarets, even the fallen one, which probably explains why it hasn't been cleared, even after all these years.

source:
A glowing honeycomb of portals surfaces on the crystal semi-sphere. There is a flash at the very center, and tiny stars radiate outwards on the network. When the stars reach a junction, they split into two or three new stars and continue to the end nodes.

Upon reaching their destinations, the lights blink three times, then disappear as the portals fail to respond. One by one the stars and the portals vanish. With the sequence ended, only two remain. One is represented by a ziggurat, the other a tower.

The image flashes red and disappears before you can do anything.
target_draft:
光り輝く蜂の巣状の転移門群が、水晶の半球上へ浮かび上がる。中央で光が閃き、ネットワーク上を小さな星々が外側へ広がっていく。星が分岐点へ到達すると二つか三つに分かれ、それぞれ終端へ向かって進み続ける。

目的地へ着くと、光は三度点滅し、転移門から応答がないまま消える。一つ、また一つと星と転移門が消えていく。流れが終わると、残るのは二つだけ。一つはジッグラト、もう一つは塔で示されている。

映像が赤く点滅し、何かする間もなく消える。

source:
The doors slide with a whisper into the wall and two assistants in thick leather aprons and blacksmith's gloves wheel in a cart with a grotesque body laid upon it. For some reason, it's also strapped down.

"Get him into the tank," the magus says in an unemotional, even bored, voice. The creature clearly makes little impression on him.

“It’s his second time this month,” says a man next to him, wearing an impossibly white robe. “I think he likes it here.”

“What’s not to like?” replies the magus, shaking his head as the assistants move warily around the sides of the cart. “I'll need a full report this time, including the rad count, just in case.”
target_draft:
扉が囁くような音を立てて壁の中へ滑り込み、厚い革前掛けと鍛冶用手袋を身につけた助手二人が、醜悪な身体を載せた台車を押して入ってくる。なぜか、その身体は拘束までされている。

「槽へ入れろ。」魔導士は感情のない、退屈そうですらある声で言う。その怪物を見ても、ほとんど何も感じていないようだ。

「今月二度目です。」隣に立つ、あり得ないほど白いローブの男が言う。「ここが気に入ってるんじゃないですか。」

「気に入らない理由があるか？」魔導士は首を振り、助手たちが警戒しながら台車の両側を動くのを見る。「今回は完全な報告書を頼む。念のため放射線量も含めろ。」

source:
He steps forward and raises his voice as if addressing a group of gladiators on the arena floor. “Our patient must be able to walk out of here under his own strength in two weeks, no more, so let’s get to work. Bron, hook up the life support first or he'll be brain dead in half an hour. The patient needs a full organ bypass, but we have the machines for that now. As soon as blood prep is done, we can figure out what to keep and what to throw away. Anything running at 80% or less we swap out. We don’t want him back in a week for kidney failure, do we?”

A rumbling growl comes from the giant's chest and he arches his back, clawing with one meaty hand at the restraints. A red stain seeps into his bandages and the air above him wavers from the heat of his skin.

“Drain his hydrogen sac, now,” yells the man in white, his calm control wavering. “If his inhibitor levels fall too low, we'll lose the entire mountain.”
target_draft:
彼は一歩前へ出ると、闘技場の剣闘士たちへ号令するように声を張る。「患者は二週間以内、自力でここを歩いて出られなければならない。それ以上は駄目だ。さあ始めるぞ。ブロン、まず生命維持装置へ繋げ。でないと三十分で脳死だ。患者には全臓器のバイパスが必要だが、今はそのための機械がある。血液の準備が済み次第、何を残して何を捨てるか決める。80％以下しか機能してないものは全部交換だ。一週間後に腎不全で戻ってきてもらっちゃ困るだろ？」

巨人の胸から地鳴りのような唸り声が上がり、背を反らし、肉厚な片手で拘束具を引っ掻く。包帯へ赤い染みが広がり、皮膚の熱で上の空気が揺らめく。

「水素嚢を抜け、今すぐだ！」白衣の男が叫び、落ち着いた統制が揺らぐ。「抑制剤の濃度が下がりすぎたら、山ごと失うぞ。」

source:
The assistant scramble to fix several tubes, some carrying enriched blood, others an unknown blue compound, into a series of small artificial apertures on the giant's torso. Soon the patient is stable and they begin to work on shifting him into the tank.

“Well done,” says the magus.

“We do what we can,” says the man in white, “but it only gets harder. Hellfyre? If *he* is barely conscious...” He doesn’t finish.

“We lost four legions,” says the magus, “if that’s what you’re asking. We took one of them down as well, so it’s two against two now, not four against three. But Agathoth isn’t a fighter, so do whatever it takes to keep Hassatur alive. If we lose him, our casualties will go up tenfold.”
target_draft:

「よくやった。」魔導士が言う。

「できることをしてるだけです。」白衣の男が言う。「だが、どんどん難しくなってる。ヘルファイアが？　もし*彼*ですら意識がほとんどないなら……」そこで言葉を切る。

source:
Born into an impoverished noble family, Athanasius was destined to support his older brother who, by virtue of being the firstborn, was entitled to what little the family had. His siblings were expected to labor day and night to secure his future, in hopes of being rewarded when that day would come.

Athanasius, a charismatic and clever youth, decided to secure his own future instead and took a job as a scribe at the castle, expecting to make a meteoric rise. Unfortunately, he discovered that the court was full of hopeful, charismatic, and clever boys, fighting for the very few positions of any value that were generally held by men who had no intentions to vacate them in the near future.

After ten years of learning the trade of scheming and plotting, Athanasius decided that he had had enough and did the unthinkable for a noble born – he joined the guild of merchants where his talents were needed and appreciated.

“Though the Tngri was mighty and terrible to behold, the great khan was unafraid. Pointing at the many tumens standing ready behind him, the great khan refused to offer tribute. “The khan clapped and the tumens descended on the Tngri like a pack of steppe wolves on an injured lamb. Three days and three nights did the battle last, for even a wounded Tngri is still a Tngri, but in the end he was slain, his body quartered and the pieces burned, the ashes cast to the four winds. source: An observant person could deduce much about Legatus Pavola by his rank and posting. Maadoran is the last place where troubles are expected, which means that the legatus’ abilities weren’t needed elsewhere, which means they weren’t needed at all. At the same time, it was an important post, which could only be given to a reliable officer accustomed to carrying out orders quickly and efficiently, without ever questioning them. source:
“Alright. So, yeah, I served Antidas, but it was more than a job for me. I took the oath and meant every word, gods help me. I didn’t believe any of the ‘Antidas, the last emperor!’ bullshit that the court poet always went on about. For me, what mattered was that Antidas actually gave a shit.

“I'd worked for the Commercium years before, so I knew how rich bastards can treat you, but Antidas was different. He'd actually spend time with his men. He said the prophecy wasn't just about him, that we were all part of it, and that the words themselves were just empty blather without good men to back them up and follow his lead. We were the foundation upon which the House was built, he said. Fine words, though I know it must sound like so much horseshit coming from me.”
target_draft:
「分かった。俺はアンティダスに仕えてた。だが、ただの仕事以上だった。誓いを立てて、その言葉を全部本気で信じてた。神々に誓ってな。宮廷詩人がいつも喚いてた『最後の皇帝アンティダス！』なんて戯言を信じてたわけじゃない。俺にとって大事だったのは、アンティダスが本当に部下のことを気にかけてたってことだ。

「何年も前にコメルキウムで働いたことがあるから、金持ちのクソ野郎どもが人をどう扱うかは知ってた。だがアンティダスは違った。実際に兵と時間を過ごした。予言は自分一人のものじゃない、俺たち全員がその一部だと言った。自分の言葉だけじゃ空虚な戯言で、それを支え、後に続く善良な男たちがいて初めて意味を持つとな。俺たちこそ家を支える土台だ、と。立派な言葉だろ。まあ、今の俺が言っても糞話にしか聞こえないだろうが。」
speaker: Beggar

source:
“Things were really gearing up by the time I'd joined. His father had left him the throne less than a year prior, you see, so Antidas was chomping at the bit to get things rolling, considering how cautious and miserly his father had been. He spent a lot of gold on payroll so his recruiters could compete with the Imperial Guards, and began outfitting his men in armor of the grand old Imperial style.

“Pretty soon the common folk took House Daratan for the real descendant of the Empire, while the so called ‘Imperial’ Guard took the role of a shameful pretender staffed by ill-armored lepers. The ranks began to swell, and in a little over half a year, Antidas was ready to stake his claim.”
target_draft:
「俺が入った頃には、もう大きく動き始めてた。父親が死んでアンティダスが玉座を継いでから、まだ一年も経ってなかった。親父は慎重でケチだったから、アンティダスは早く動きたくて仕方なかったんだ。募集係が帝国衛兵団と張り合えるよう給料へ大金を使い、兵には古き帝国風の立派な鎧を着せ始めた。

「するとすぐ、庶民はダラタン家こそ帝国の正統な後継者だと思うようになった。対して、いわゆる“帝国”衛兵団の方が、ぼろい鎧の病人を集めただけの恥ずべき偽物扱いだ。兵はどんどん増え、半年ちょっとでアンティダスは名乗りを上げる準備を整えた。」
speaker: Beggar

source:
“Luck favored Antidas. The Ordu had begun a huge push to the south, and Gaelius had to bleed his own legions to beef up the Guards to the north. Gaelius knew it would risk the legitimacy of the Charter if he did nothing but spend his time with some Bactrian belly dancers, while the Guards died defending his backyard from the greatest threat since the Qantari, so he didn't have much choice in this matter.

“That whole mess took Gaelius' carefully arranged game board and threw it into the Abyss, and Antidas was poised to exploit the situation. He sent his uncle to Ganezzar to sell Meru on a joint attack against Gaelius. He gave him a hundred soldiers and guess who was in charge of that entourage? Yours truly. Meru’s mind was soft like clay, easy to mold, and the deal was struck within a week. Soon after, we were ready to march to war.”
target_draft:
「幸運はアンティダスに味方した。オルドゥが南へ大攻勢を始め、ガエリウスは北の衛兵団を増強するため、自分の軍団まで削らなきゃならなくなった。衛兵団がカンターリ以来最大の脅威から自分の裏庭を守って死んでるのに、自分だけバクトリア人の踊り子と遊んでたら、憲章の正統性が揺らぐ。ガエリウスにも選択肢はほとんどなかった。

「その騒ぎで、ガエリウスが丹念に並べてた盤面は深淵へ放り込まれたも同然だった。アンティダスはそこへつけ込もうとした。叔父をガネザールへ送り、メルを説得してガエリウスへ共同攻撃を仕掛けさせた。兵を百人つけた。で、その一行を率いてたのは誰だと思う？　この俺だ。メルの頭は粘土みたいに柔らかくて、好きな形にできた。一週間もしないうちに話はまとまった。すぐに俺たちは戦争へ向かう準備を整えた。」
speaker: Beggar

source:
“With Gaelius fighting a war on three sides, the Daratan front had become his soft underbelly. This was still Aurelian though and Daratan was still the weakest House, so there was no certain outcome. Nonetheless, Antidas belted Gaelius with everything he had. I don't know whether tactics or numbers won that first battle, but we absolutely bled those bastards!

“House Daratan had accomplished a decisive victory, the first in decades, but all Antidas did was salute his men and walk the battlefield as calmly as if he were enjoying a stroll in the garden. He wanted it to seem as though this was all a matter of course. It must have taken a godly effort to hold in the pride he felt, and as for us, hell, we didn't even bother trying.”
target_draft:
「ガエリウスが三正面で戦争してたから、ダラタン方面が奴の柔らかい腹になった。それでもアウレリアン家はアウレリアン家、ダラタン家は最弱の家だ。勝てる保証なんてなかった。だがアンティダスは持てるもの全部をガエリウスへ叩きつけた。最初の戦いで勝ったのが戦術のおかげか数のおかげかは知らん。だが、あのクソどもにはたっぷり血を流させた！

「ダラタン家にとって何十年ぶりかの決定的勝利だった。なのにアンティダスは兵へ敬礼しただけで、庭を散歩するみたいに平然と戦場を歩いた。当然の結果だったように見せたかったんだろう。内心の誇りを押し殺すのは、神業みたいに大変だったはずだ。俺たち？　そんな努力は最初からしなかったよ。」

source:
“Well, it all went to shit, of course, but you already know that, don’t you? Things went well enough during the first month after the initial attack. Aurelian withdrew, Daratan advanced. Then one day we got word from the northeast that Meru had suddenly withdrawn his troops from the field. They hadn't been routed; they'd just completely ditched the war! Antidas didn’t know what to think. Had Meru been bribed by Gaelius? Had he lost his nerve?

“It turns out Meru hadn't lost his nerve, just his whole fucking mind. I brought Antidas’ uncle to Ganezzar again and he didn't even greet us when we walked into his court, but instead began a crazed oration. It was like we were listening to a totally different man. He spoke of gods, he spoke of revelations, he spoke of the people, and he ultimately just spewed out a mess of the most impassioned insanity I'd ever heard.

“At first we hoped it was nothing but an act to cover Meru's real doubts about the war and so the uncle stayed into the night to discuss it with him further. When he finally came out of the palace, his skin white as gypsum. I tried to fish out some of the details, but he the only thing he said was, “Gods help us, he actually believes every word. It's all over...” And so it was.”
target_draft:
「まあ、全部クソみたいに崩れた。知ってるだろ？　最初の攻撃から一か月くらいは上手くいってた。アウレリアン家は退き、ダラタン家は進んだ。ところがある日、北東から知らせが来た。メルが突然、軍を戦場から引き揚げたってな。敗走したんじゃない。本当に戦争そのものを放り出したんだ！　アンティダスにも訳が分からなかった。ガエリウスに買収されたのか？　怖気づいたのか？

source:

Except, Gaelius’ legions, of course,” laughs the beggar, the laugh turning into a violent cough that stops him for a moment.

“Wiraz,” he says finally as if the name still invoked pain. “It was a disaster. Complete and utter fucking disaster. If Antidas didn’t run, he would have lost everything there. source: "Long way from home, <charname>." Dias steps out from the shadows. "Made a new friend?" he asks casually and pulls out his dagger.
target_draft: 「ずいぶん遠くまで来たな、<charname>。」ディアスが物陰から姿を現す。「新しい友達でもできたか？」何気ない口調でそう尋ね、短剣を抜く。
speaker: Dias

source:
Specks of dust drift silently through twin beams of light coming from two holes in the wall - the only illumination in this darkened room. Dias points at his crossbow and the holes.

You look through one of the holes and see Carrinas talking to another man. You don't have a perfect shot, but you doubt that you would miss when you're this close. You are pretty sure that Dias won't. Carrinas is as good as dead now, which means ... a lot of things. It's time to make a decision.
target_draft:
壁に開いた二つの穴から差し込む細い光。その二本の光だけが、暗い部屋を照らしている。埃の粒がその中を音もなく漂っている。ディアスは自分のクロスボウと、その穴を指差す。

片方の穴を覗くと、カリナスが別の男と話している。完璧な射線ではないが、これほど近ければ外すとは思えない。ディアスならなおさらだ。カリナスはもう死んだも同然。つまり……いろいろな意味を持つ。決断の時だ。

source: Wait for Dias' sign and shoot Commander Carrinas.
target_draft: ディアスの合図を待ち、カリナス司令官を撃つ。

source: Shoot Dias instead to save Commander Carrinas' life.
target_draft: カリナス司令官を救うため、代わりにディアスを撃つ。

source: Dias aims his crossbow, looks at you and nods. You pull the trigger and your bolt hits Carrinas in the shoulder, spinning him around before Dias' bolt slams into his chest and throws him across the room. Wasting no time, Dias grabs the rope and jumps out of the window, sliding down.
target_draft: ディアスはクロスボウを構え、あなたを見て頷く。引き金を引くと、ボルトがカリナスの肩へ突き刺さって身体をひねらせる。そこへディアスのボルトが胸に食い込み、部屋の向こうへ吹き飛ばす。ディアスは一瞬も無駄にせず縄を掴み、窓から飛び出して滑り降りる。

source: Grab the rope and follow Dias.
target_draft: 縄を掴み、ディアスの後を追う。

source: Put on the merchant robes and talk your way out.
target_draft: 商人のローブを着て、話術で切り抜ける。

source: You land softly in the alley behind the inn when the guards raise the alarm. Several guards enter the alley from the side and move slowly searching for any signs of the assassins. Dias disappears into the darkness, moving soundlessly.
target_draft: 宿の裏手の路地へ静かに着地したところで、衛兵たちが警報を上げる。数人の衛兵が横手から路地へ入り、暗殺者の痕跡を探しながら慎重に進んでくる。ディアスは音もなく闇へ消えていく。
[sneak]衛兵たちの横を気づかれずに抜ける。

source: [failure]You move as quietly as you can, but a sharp pain in your arm breaks your concentration. A pilum thrown by one of the soldiers tells you that you have been noticed and have no option but to run back to the guild.
target_draft: [failure]できる限り音を立てずに進むが、腕に走った鋭い痛みで集中が途切れる。兵士の一人が投げたピルムが刺さり、見つかったことを悟る。選択肢はない。ギルドまで逃げ戻る。
ギルドまで走って戻る。

source: [success]Staying in the shadows and making no sound, you move like a ghost. The guards pass several feet from you without detecting your presence.
target_draft: [success]物陰に身を隠し、物音一つ立てず、幽霊のように進む。衛兵たちは数歩先を通り過ぎても、あなたの存在に気づかない。

source:
You finally reach the safety of the guild. Neleos smiles, welcoming you back, but the smile doesn't last long. You hear angry shouts in the alley behind you. Turning around, you see flaming arrows flying through the darkness toward your guild. Instantly, the roof catches fire, illuminating the alley. You see a group of Imperial Guards preparing to charge. A larger group approaches from the north.

"Coltan, take Fulvio and <charname> and take care of the guards in the alley. We'll deal with the other group and keep them away from you."
target_draft:
ようやくギルドの安全な場所までたどり着く。ネレオスは笑顔で迎えるが、その笑みは長く続かない。背後の路地から怒号が聞こえる。振り返ると、暗闇を裂いて火矢がギルドへ飛んでくる。たちまち屋根に火がつき、路地が照らし出される。帝国衛兵団の一隊が突撃の準備をしている。さらに北側から、もっと大きな集団が近づいてくる。

「コルタン、フルウィオと<charname>を連れて、路地の衛兵を片づけろ。俺たちはもう一方を相手にして、お前たちへ近づけさせない。」
speaker: Neleos

target_draft: コルタンについていく。
speaker: Neleos

source:
You follow Coltan outside. The guards are advancing slowly, clearly expecting an ambush. Coltan glances at the heavy armor and replaces a standard bolt with an armor-piercing one.

"Are you just going to stand there?" he asks calmly and pulls the trigger.
target_draft:
コルタンについて外へ出る。衛兵たちは明らかに待ち伏せを警戒し、ゆっくり前進している。コルタンは重装鎧へ目をやると、通常のボルトを徹甲用のものへ取り替える。

「そこで突っ立ってるつもりか？」落ち着いた口調で言い、引き金を引く。

source: You put on the robes and get ready. The door flies wide open and the guards burst into the room. Judging by their expressions, they are not looking for justice; they are looking for blood. A lot of blood. Maybe you should have taken the window.
target_draft: ローブを身につけ、身構える。扉が勢いよく開き、衛兵たちが部屋へなだれ込んでくる。その表情を見る限り、正義を求めているわけではない。求めているのは血だ。それも大量の。窓から逃げた方がよかったかもしれない。

source: [impersonate]"Assassins! I saw them! They fled through the window. They were going to kill me! Thank you for coming to rescue me!"
target_draft: [impersonate]「暗殺者だ！　見た！　窓から逃げた！　俺を殺そうとしてたんだ！　助けに来てくれてありがとう！」

source: [failure]The Guard runs you through with his sword, interrupting you mid-word. You die before you hit the floor.
target_draft: [failure]言葉を最後まで言い切る前に、衛兵の剣が身体を貫く。床に倒れるより先に死ぬ。

source: [success]The Guard's sword stops an inch from your throat. "Who. Are. You?"
target_draft: [success]衛兵の剣先が喉元から指一本ほどのところで止まる。「お前は。何者だ？」

source: [impersonate][charisma]"I'm a trader. I rented this room yesterday and then..."
target_draft: [impersonate][charisma]「商人だ。昨日この部屋を借りて、それから……」

source: [impersonate][charisma]"My name is Manius Cotta. I'm a caravan-master from Atrion. I came to Teron yester–" Break your voice and start weeping. "When they broke in, I was scared, so scared... I thought that..."
target_draft: [impersonate][charisma]「名前はマニウス・コッタ。アトリオンから来た隊商長だ。昨日テロンへ来て――」声を詰まらせ、泣き始める。「あいつらが押し入ってきた時、怖くて、怖くて……俺はてっきり……」

source: [failure]A downward slash nearly separates your head from the shoulder. You die before you hit the floor.
target_draft: [failure]振り下ろされた一撃で、首が肩からほとんど切り離される。床に倒れるより先に死ぬ。

source: [success]The Guard lowers the sword and angrily pushes you away. He sends his men downstairs and leaves the room.
target_draft: [success]衛兵は剣を下ろし、苛立たしげにあなたを突き放す。部下を階下へ向かわせ、自分も部屋を出ていく。
カリナスの様子を確かめる。

source:
[success]"Check it out." One of the guards goes downstairs, while you wait with the sword at your throat. He comes back after what seems like a very long time and nods to the Centurion. The sword withdraws.

The guards run downstairs, leaving you alone in the room.
target_draft:
[success]「確認しろ。」衛兵の一人が階下へ向かい、その間あなたは喉元へ剣を突きつけられたまま待つ。途方もなく長く感じる時間の後、男が戻ってきて百人隊長へ頷く。剣が引かれる。

衛兵たちは階下へ駆け下り、あなた一人が部屋に残される。
カリナスの様子を確かめる。

source: The room is in disarray. Carrinas lies on his back with the bolts sticking out of his chest and shoulder. The man he was meeting with is long gone. There is a single guard waiting near the body.
target_draft: 部屋はひどく荒れている。カリナスは仰向けに倒れ、胸と肩からボルトが突き出している。会っていた男はとっくに消えている。死体のそばには衛兵が一人だけ残っている。

source: [critical strike]Take him out without attracting any more attention.
target_draft: [critical strike]これ以上騒ぎを起こさずに始末する。

source:
You point the crossbow at Dias and shoot him almost point blank. The force of the impact throws his body against the wall, making plenty of noise. The guards posted outside barge in, their swords ready. You point at Dias' body, saying "assassin" and wait.

You don't have to wait long. Carrinas walks in, surrounded by guards. He looks at the drilled holes, at the body and the crossbow with a steel bolt glinting in the light. Then he looks at you. "Why did you do it?"
target_draft:
クロスボウをディアスへ向け、ほとんど至近距離から撃つ。衝撃でディアスの身体が壁へ叩きつけられ、大きな音を立てる。外に配置されていた衛兵たちが剣を構えて突入してくる。あなたはディアスの死体を指し、「暗殺者だ」とだけ告げて待つ。

長く待つ必要はない。カリナスが衛兵たちに囲まれて入ってくる。壁に開けられた穴、死体、光を反射する鋼鉄製ボルトの装填されたクロスボウを順に見る。そしてあなたへ視線を向ける。「なぜやった？」
speaker: Carrinas

source: "I've decided that I'm on the wrong side of the upcoming fight."
target_draft: 「これから始まる戦いで、つく側を間違えていたと気づいた。」
speaker: Carrinas

source: "I figured you'd pay me more for saving your life than the guild would have paid me for taking it."
target_draft: 「お前の命を救った報酬の方が、ギルドから暗殺料としてもらえる額より高いと思った。」
speaker: Carrinas

source: "Why should I hire you? You've just killed your partner and betrayed your guild. You know what they say about traitors..."
target_draft: 「なぜお前を雇わなければならない？　つい今しがた相棒を殺し、ギルドを裏切ったばかりだろう。裏切り者がどう言われるかは知っているはずだ……」
speaker: Carrinas

source: "The Boatmen should have never accepted that contract in the first place. The way I see it, they betrayed me."
target_draft: 「ステュクスの渡し守は、そもそもあの依頼を受けるべきじゃなかった。俺から見れば、裏切ったのは向こうだ。」
speaker: Carrinas

source: "A mercenary? Pay him 1000 imperials." He says to one of his men and walks out.
target_draft: 「傭兵か？　1000インペリアル払ってやれ。」部下の一人へそう言い残し、立ち去る。
speaker: Carrinas

source: Leave and wait for the morning.
speaker: Carrinas

source:
"Then help me finish it. Go back to the guild. My men will follow you, staying out of sight. Neleos doesn't know that the assassination has failed. He trusts you," Carrinas sneers, "so get close enough and kill him. Once he's down, my men will attack and the Boatmen will be finished. Once and for all.

"Take this." He removes a vial on a chain from his neck and hands it to you. "It contains the magic of the old days. Drink it before you strike and you will move with the speed of lightning, striking your enemies down before they react. The effect doesn't last long though, but it will make a difference. Trust me."
target_draft:
「なら最後まで手を貸せ。ギルドへ戻れ。俺の部下が姿を隠して後を追う。暗殺が失敗したことをネレオスは知らない。奴はお前を信用している。」カリナスは冷笑する。「十分近づいて殺せ。ネレオスが倒れたら、俺の部下が突入する。そうすればステュクスの渡し守は終わりだ。今度こそ完全にな。

「これを持っていけ。」首に掛けていた小瓶を外し、あなたへ渡す。「古代の魔法が封じられている。仕掛ける直前に飲めば、雷のような速さで動き、敵が反応する前に倒せる。長くは続かないが、十分な差にはなる。俺を信じろ。」
speaker: Carrinas

source: "Very well." Go back to the guild.
speaker: Carrinas

source:
You return to the guild, pausing for a second and holding the vial Carrinas gave you. It's a rare thing and should be used wisely, if at all.

With or without the vial, you won't last long against four assassins. The guards won't attack until Neleos is dead, so taking him out is your priority. The vial will greatly increase your chances to kill Neleos with one strike, but you'd have to drink it before you enter and you'd have time for one or two strikes at most. Alternatively, you can rely on your own skills to take Neleos out fast and drink the vial once the fighting starts to keep you alive until the cavalry shows up.
target_draft:
ギルドへ戻る。カリナスから渡された小瓶を手に、しばし足を止める。珍しい品だ。使うにしても、慎重に使うべきだろう。

小瓶を使おうが使うまいが、暗殺者四人を相手に長くはもたない。衛兵たちはネレオスが死ぬまで攻撃しない。だから最優先は奴を仕留めることだ。小瓶を飲めば、一撃でネレオスを殺せる可能性は大きく上がる。だが入る前に飲まなければならず、効果が続くのはせいぜい一、二撃分だ。あるいは自分の技量に賭けて素早くネレオスを倒し、戦闘が始まってから小瓶を飲み、援軍が来るまで生き延びる手もある。

source: [dexterity][critical strike]Drink the vial before entering the guild, then attack Neleos without wasting any time.
target_draft: [dexterity][critical strike]ギルドへ入る前に小瓶を飲み、間を置かずネレオスを襲う。

source: Enter the guild, wait for a good opportunity and attack.
target_draft: ギルドへ入り、好機を待って攻撃する。

source: This is suicide. Just leave them to their fate.
target_draft: これは自殺行為だ。あとは奴らの運命に任せて立ち去る。

source:
[success]You kick the door open, moving in and attacking almost immediately. At first you're not sure that the vial worked, as you don't seem to be moving any faster. You strike several times in rapid succession testing Neleos' defences and notice that Neleos' reaction is a bit sluggish.

He barely manages to dodge the first two attacks but fails to move in time to avoid the third one and the blade sinks to the hilt between his ribs. You pull the dagger out, slashing around in a quick, blurry motion. The blade connects with Fulvio's throat, opening it up and sending a fountain of blood into the air. Then everything speeds up, as the two bodies fall to the ground, and Agatai cautiously steps forward as Coltan lifts up his crossbow taking aim.
target_draft:
[success]扉を蹴り開け、ほとんど間を置かずに踏み込んで攻撃する。最初は小瓶が効いたのか分からない。自分の動きが速くなったようには感じないからだ。ネレオスの防御を試すように素早く何度か斬りつけると、奴の反応がわずかに鈍いことに気づく。

最初の二撃は辛うじてかわされるが、三撃目には間に合わず、刃が肋骨の間へ柄まで深く突き刺さる。短剣を引き抜き、残像が残るほどの速さで横薙ぎに振るう。刃はフルウィオの喉を捉え、切り裂かれた傷口から血が噴き上がる。二人の身体が床へ崩れ落ちると、すべてが元の速さへ戻る。アガタイが慎重に一歩前へ出て、コルタンはクロスボウを持ち上げて狙いを定める。

"I think it's safe to say that the guild is no longer off limits." His smile is back. It looks menacing. "They've broken the rules and there's no going back now. We're lucky that only a few enraged guards showed up tonight. Tomorrow they will come in full force to finish the job and we won't be able to stop them. We have no choice but to hit them first."

"Hit them first?" Dias interrupts suddenly. "You want to hit their barracks? It's a suicide mission."
target_draft:
「もうギルドが不可侵だとは言えんな。」笑みが戻っている。だが今度は不穏な笑みだ。「奴らは決まりを破った。もう後戻りはできない。今夜来たのが、怒り狂った衛兵の一部だけだったのは幸運だった。明日には総力で仕留めに来る。そうなれば俺たちには止められない。先に叩くしかない。」

「先に叩く？」ディアスが突然口を挟む。「兵舎を襲う気か？　自殺行為だぞ。」
speaker: Neleos

source:
"Normally it would be," says Neleos, "but tonight is different. Their Commander died today, remember? Not only will they be caught off guard, but most men will be too drunk to hold a sword."

"Why are you doing this, Neleos?" Looks like Dias decided to take a stand. "Sure, some guards took it a bit too far. It's unfortunate, but hardly worth declaring a war on the entire army.

"Let it go, Neleos. Tomorrow will be a different day. The guards will wake up and face reality. Carrinas is gone and his plans are gone with him. His officers will be too busy fighting for the recently vacated position to attack us. Let bygones be bygones."
target_draft:
「普段ならな。」ネレオスが言う。「だが今夜は違う。司令官が今日死んだのを忘れたか？　不意を突けるだけじゃない。大半の兵は、剣も握れないほど酔っているはずだ。」

「なぜそこまでやるんだ、ネレオス？」どうやらディアスは譲らないつもりらしい。「確かに、衛兵の何人かはやりすぎた。不幸なことだ。だが軍全体に戦争を仕掛けるほどじゃない。

「もう終わりにしろ、ネレオス。明日はまた違う日だ。衛兵たちも目を覚まして現実を見る。カリナスは死んだ。奴の計画も一緒に消えた。士官どもは空いた地位の奪い合いで忙しくなり、俺たちを攻めている暇なんてない。過ぎたことは水に流せ。」
speaker: Neleos

source:
"You're not a guildmaster yet, Dias, so don't act like one," snaps Neleos. "I too want to believe that tomorrow everything will go back to normal, but what if it doesn't? We'll be slaughtered like rats here, when the guards throw everything they have at us.

"Truth be told, I didn't want to take this contract, but what's done is done. Now, we have to finish it. Are you with me?"

Dias looks at Neleos for awhile, then nods reluctantly and steps aside. One by one, everyone signs up to follow Neleos to hell and hopefully back. Your turn.
target_draft:
「まだギルドマスターでもないくせに、ギルドマスター気取りはやめろ、ディアス。」ネレオスが吐き捨てる。「俺だって、明日になれば全部元通りになると信じたい。だが、そうならなかったら？　衛兵が総力で押し寄せれば、俺たちはここで鼠みたいに皆殺しだ。

「本音を言えば、この依頼は受けたくなかった。だがもうやってしまった。なら最後まで片づけるしかない。俺についてくるか？」

ディアスはしばらくネレオスを見つめ、それから渋々頷いて脇へ下がる。一人、また一人と、皆がネレオスについて地獄まで行き、願わくば戻ってくることに同意していく。次はあなたの番だ。
speaker: Neleos

source: "Sorry, Neleos. I've gone as far as I can with you."
target_draft: 「悪いな、ネレオス。俺はここまでだ。」
speaker: Neleos

source:
Neleos is silent for a while then draws himself up straight.

"<charname>, for refusing a necessary contract and thus failing the guild, you are no longer part of us. We withdraw our protection and are no longer your brothers. Leave... now."
target_draft:
ネレオスはしばらく黙り、それから背筋を伸ばす。

「<charname>。必要な依頼を拒み、ギルドの期待を裏切った。よって、お前はもう仲間ではない。今後、俺たちはお前を守らないし、兄弟でもない。出ていけ……今すぐに。」
speaker: Neleos

source:
You look at the dead bodies sprawled around you and the blood slowly spreading on the floor. The guards never showed up to back you up. Well, fuck them. You managed without them.

You hear footsteps and Carrinas walks in, followed by the guards. "Not bad," he says with a smile, "not bad at all. I wanted to see how you'd handle a real fight. Everyone can shoot a man through a hole, but it takes guts to face several armed men openly and kill them all. That's what separates the Imperial Guards from assassins.

"Welcome to the club, <charname>. Come and see me after you rest. We have a lot of work to do."
target_draft:
周囲に転がる死体と、床へゆっくり広がっていく血を見る。衛兵は援護に現れなかった。まあ、クソくらえだ。奴らなしでも何とかなった。

足音が聞こえ、衛兵たちを従えたカリナスが入ってくる。「悪くない。」彼は笑う。「なかなかだ。本当の戦いでどう動くか見たかった。穴越しに人を撃つだけなら誰にでもできる。だが、武装した男を何人も正面から相手にして皆殺しにするには胆力が要る。それが帝国衛兵団と暗殺者の違いだ。

「仲間入りを歓迎する、<charname>。休んだら俺のところへ来い。仕事は山ほどある。」
speaker: Carrinas

"Wait," says Coltan suddenly. He reaches inside his sash and produces a small vial. "I owe you my life and I'd like to repay the debt. Coat your weapons with this poison and wait for it to dry. It will give you the edge you'll need to walk away with your life. It's one of my best. I kept it for special customers." Coltan chuckles.

"Good luck, <charname>."

「待て。」コルタンが突然言う。帯の中へ手を入れ、小さな瓶を取り出す。「命を借りたままじゃ気分が悪い。返させてくれ。この毒を武器に塗って、乾くまで待て。生きて帰るために必要な優位をくれるはずだ。俺の自信作の一つでな。特別な客のために取っておいた。」コルタンはくすりと笑う。

Another body lies a few meters away; the wall above is covered with blood splatters. Regardless of how it ends, it will be a while before the Guards forget this day.
target_draft: 兵舎へ入る。最初に目に入るのは、驚いた表情を若い顔に残したまま死んでいる衛兵だ。消えた松明を手にしており、剣はまだ鞘に収まっている。数メートル先には別の死体があり、その上の壁には血しぶきが飛び散っている。どう終わるにせよ、衛兵たちがこの日を忘れるには長い時間がかかるだろう。

source: The dining room is full of empty bottles and dead bodies. Nearly a dozen soldiers who had passed out drunk have been slain in their sleep. The smell of spilt blood is so strong that you can almost taste the coppery tang. You find Agatai lying face down - an axe buried in his back.
target_draft: 食堂は空き瓶と死体で埋め尽くされている。酒に潰れて眠り込んでいた十人近い兵士が、眠ったまま殺されている。こぼれた血の匂いがあまりに濃く、口の中に鉄の味を感じるほどだ。うつ伏せに倒れたアガタイを見つける。背中には斧が深く突き刺さっている。

source: You find Dias in one of the rooms. He's sitting on his knees near the door, propped up by the spear in his chest. The bodies of five guardsmen are strewn about the room. From the looks of it, Dias walked into an ambush, and, despite being outnumbered, managed to kill the guardsmen before bleeding to death.
target_draft: 部屋の一つでディアスを見つける。扉のそばで膝をつき、胸を貫いた槍にもたれかかるようにしている。周囲には五人の衛兵の死体が散らばっている。見たところ、ディアスは待ち伏せに遭ったらしい。数で劣りながらも衛兵たちを全員仕留め、その後に失血死したようだ。

source: The sound of metal on metal and the grunts of combat greet you as you enter the Commander's quarters. Neleos is still alive, hard-pressed by two guards, but handling himself admirably well for an old-timer. You join the fray.
target_draft: 司令官の部屋へ入ると、金属同士がぶつかる音と戦いの呻き声が耳に飛び込んでくる。ネレオスはまだ生きている。二人の衛兵に追い詰められているが、この歳にしては見事に渡り合っている。あなたも戦いに加わる。

source:
Neleos is covered with blood, a great deal of it being his own. A nasty slash crosses his face through the left eye. The tough bastard still has enough self-control to smile. "It's been a long day, eh?" He winks with his good eye. "Did Dias or Agatai make it? No? Well, I didn't think any of us would either..."

"We've been badly hurt by this business, but I'm going to restore the local guild. It will take time though. If you need work, go to Maadoran or Ganezzar. I'll let the guild masters know that you may stop by."
target_draft:
ネレオスは全身血まみれだ。そのかなりの量が自分の血らしい。左目を横切るように、顔にはひどい裂傷が走っている。それでも、このしぶとい男にはまだ笑うだけの余裕が残っている。「長い一日だったな？」無事な方の目で片目をつぶる。「ディアスかアガタイは生き残ったか？　そうか……まあ、誰かが生きて帰れるとは思ってなかったがな……」

「今回の件で大打撃を受けたが、ここのギルドは立て直すつもりだ。時間はかかるだろうがな。仕事が必要なら、マードランかガネザールへ行け。向こうのギルドマスターには、お前が訪ねるかもしれないと伝えておく。」

source:
You arrive at the infamous Maadoran Slums, greeted only by an oppressive silence settling around you. Filth-clad figures pay you little notice as they paw through refuse piled against dilapidated buildings, yet you can feel hostile eyes watching you from the shadows.

You're keenly aware that even the Guard have long since chalked this place up as a loss. Their patrol routes avoid the squalid maze of collapsed buildings and make-shift shelters. The only authority in here is the Thieves Guild.

You can just make out their headquarters in the distance – the shattered dome of the High Temple, an everlasting mockery that serves as a reminder of this district’s fall from its former grandeur.
target_draft:
悪名高いマードランのスラムへ到着する。周囲を包むのは、重苦しい静寂だけだ。汚物まみれの人影は、崩れかけた建物の脇に積まれたゴミを漁りながら、あなたにはほとんど注意を払わない。それでも闇の中から敵意ある視線が注がれているのを感じる。

衛兵団でさえ、とっくにここを見捨てていることはよく分かる。巡回路は、崩れた建物と粗末な仮小屋が入り組む不潔な迷路を避けている。この場所で権威を持つのは盗賊ギルドだけだ。

遠くにはその本拠地が見える――大神殿の砕けた円蓋だ。かつての栄華からこの地区が転落したことを、永遠に嘲笑う記念碑のようにそびえている。

Muttering something under your breath and stopping a few times to pick a few bits and pieces from nearby piles of refuse, you make your way past several groups of armed men – the enforcers of the Thieves Guild.

source:

target_draft:
さらに数歩進んだところで、再び雷が落ちる。今度は光るエネルギー球がいくつも現れる。周囲の空中を漂い、気まぐれに飛び回りながら火花を散らしている。ゆっくり後ずさろうとするが、一歩目を踏み出した瞬間、そのうち一つがこちらへ跳ねる。

爆発で脇腹に拳大の穴が開き、そのまま倒れて死ぬ。
深淵がまた一人、犠牲者を得た。

source:

A man is hanging from the structure on four great black nails, and he is still alive, moaning loudly. Well, you were looking for a cross, although this isn’t exactly what you expected.

“Kill me,” begs the man. Looking down at a sudden weight pulling on your hand, you realize you are holding a sword.
