「たとえば、良き兵士は鎧職人に、どのような形、焼き、品質の鎧を欲するかを語ることはできる。されど、その鎧を作り、打ち、焼きを入れる術まで教えられるわけではない。それと同じく、われも完全なる廷臣がいかなる者かを語ることはできようが、汝がいかにしてその者となるかを教えることはできぬ。とはいえ、可能な限り汝の求めに応えるため……」

source: You peek outside and see a guard patrolling the hallway. The bedroom is almost at the end of the hallway, so once the guard passes it, you'd have to move fast as you'd only have no more than ten heartbeats until he turns around. Of course, if the guard is dead, you won't have to worry about it.
target_draft: 外を覗くと、衛兵が廊下を巡回している。寝室は廊下のほぼ端にあるため、衛兵が前を通り過ぎたら素早く動く必要がある。振り返るまで十拍もないだろう。もちろん、衛兵が死んでいれば気にする必要はない。
[impersonate][etiquette]上等な服を探して着替える。

source: [sneak][dexterity]Make a silent run toward the stairs leading down.
target_draft: [sneak][dexterity]階下へ続く階段まで音を立てずに駆け抜ける。

source:
[failure]You find an elegant looking set of clothes and put them on. You practice the mannerism until you're satisfied with the persona you've conjured, then step out of the bedroom and walk down the hall.

Within moments you're surrounded by several guards. You try to explain that you're a guest of Lord Antidas but the guards drag you to the dungeon for questioning.
target_draft:
[failure]上品そうな服一式を見つけて着替える。作り上げた人物像に満足するまで立ち居振る舞いを練習し、寝室を出て廊下を歩く。

ほどなく数人の衛兵に囲まれる。アンティダス卿の客だと説明しようとするが、衛兵たちは尋問のため地下牢へ引きずっていく。

source:
[success]You find an elegant looking set of clothes and put them on. You practice the mannerism until you're satisfied with the persona you've conjured, then step out of the bedroom and curse loudly. Within moments you're surrounded by several guards struggling to understand what's happening. Looking very displeased that a <man/woman> of your station has to acknowledge the existence of lowly guards and talk to them, you explain that you're a personal guest of Lord Antidas and that unless you're taken downstairs this very instant, heads will roll.

The guards glance at each other and decide that there is no harm in accompanying you downstairs. You demand more guards, claiming that a <man/woman> of your station simply can't be followed by less than twelve guards, but eventually accept a more humble escort.
target_draft:
[success]上品そうな服一式を見つけて着替える。作り上げた人物像に満足するまで立ち居振る舞いを練習し、寝室を出るなり大声で悪態をつく。たちまち何が起きたのか理解できずにいる衛兵たちが周囲へ集まってくる。身分ある<man/woman>が下賤な衛兵の存在を認め、口を利かなければならないことにひどく不快そうな顔をしながら、自分はアンティダス卿の個人的な客であり、今すぐ階下へ案内しなければ首が飛ぶと告げる。

衛兵たちは顔を見合わせ、階下まで付き添うくらいなら害はないと判断する。あなたはさらに衛兵を増やせと要求し、身分ある<man/woman>が十二人にも満たない護衛を従えるなどあり得ないと主張するが、最終的にはもっと質素な護衛で妥協する。

source: [failure]You lunge at the guard but he reacts instantly. A heavy shield is smashed into your face, blurring your vision. You see a flash of metal and suddenly pain erupts in your chest, drowning your screams and attempts to draw air. You die before your body hits the ground.
target_draft: [failure]衛兵へ飛びかかるが、相手は即座に反応する。重い盾が顔面へ叩き込まれ、視界がぼやける。金属の閃きが見えた直後、胸に激痛が走り、悲鳴も息を吸おうとする試みも飲み込んでいく。身体が地面に倒れる前に、あなたは死ぬ。

source:
[success]The guard is fast and well trained. His sword clears the scabbard and catches you as you lunge. Lucky for you, your aim was truer - your dagger finds the guard's neck and his eyes slowly roll up as he loses all interest in you.

You pull his sword out of the wound and bandage it as best as you can. The way is clear.
target_draft:
[success]衛兵は素早く、よく訓練されている。飛びかかるあなたに合わせ、剣を抜きざまに斬りつけてくる。幸運にも狙いはこちらの方が正確だった。短剣が衛兵の首を捉え、目がゆっくり上を向き、あなたへの興味を完全に失う。

傷口から相手の剣を引き抜き、できる限り包帯を巻く。道は開いた。

source: [success]The guard is fast and well trained, but he is no match for you. By the time he raises his shield, your dagger is buried in his neck and his eyes slowly roll up, losing any interest in you. The way is clear.
target_draft: [success]衛兵は素早く、よく訓練されている。だがあなたには及ばない。相手が盾を構える頃には、短剣が首に埋まり、目がゆっくり上を向いて、あなたへの興味を完全に失っている。道は開いた。

source: You wait for the servants to leave, then sneak inside. The only items of interests are several golden goblets and a well crafted steel dagger used for carving meat. You pocket them while considering what to do next.
target_draft: 使用人たちが去るまで待ち、食堂へ忍び込む。目につくのは金の杯が数個と、肉を切り分けるための出来のよい鋼の短剣くらいだ。それらを懐へ収めながら、次にどうするか考える。

source: [failure]You wait for the guard to pass, then dart into the hallway and run as silently as you can, counting the heartbeats. "What the..." followed by "Stop!" tells you that you've failed. You don't hear any footsteps and for a moment there you think that you have a chance. Then a javelin violently bursts through your chest, shattering your hopes. You take a few weak steps, leaving a bloody smear where you use the wall for support, then slide down and watch as the life pours from your body.
target_draft: [failure]衛兵が通り過ぎるのを待ち、廊下へ飛び出して、鼓動を数えながらできるだけ静かに走る。「何だ……」に続く「止まれ！」の声で、失敗したと分かる。足音は聞こえず、一瞬だけ逃げ切れるかと思う。だが次の瞬間、投槍が背中から胸へ突き抜け、その希望を粉々にする。よろめきながら数歩進み、壁に手をついた跡へ血を残し、そのままずるずると座り込んで、自分の身体から命が流れ出していくのを見つめる。

source: [success]You wait for the guard to pass, then dart into the hallway and run as silently as you can, counting the heartbeats. It's clear that you won't make to the stairs leading down in time. You see two rooms up ahead. The guard behind you will reach the end of the hallway and turn around at any moment now. You have no choice but to pick a room and hope for the best.
target_draft: [success]衛兵が通り過ぎるのを待ち、廊下へ飛び出して、鼓動を数えながらできるだけ静かに走る。だが階下へ続く階段までは間に合わない。前方に部屋が二つ見える。背後の衛兵が廊下の端へ達して振り返るまで、もう一瞬しかない。どちらかの部屋を選び、幸運を祈るしかない。

source: You duck into the room on your left. It's a display room where Antidas keeps his ancient curiosities. It's empty at the moment, but it's wide open and you will be fully exposed if someone were to walk in.
target_draft: 左の部屋へ飛び込む。アンティダスが古代の珍品を飾っている展示室だ。今は無人だが、開けた部屋なので、誰かが入ってくれば完全に丸見えになる。

source:
[sneak failure]You duck into the room on your right. It's a dining chamber. Several servants are clearing up a recent meal, their eyes fixed on their tasks. You roll under a large oak table but one of the servants sees and raises the alarm.

Before you can even grasp the situation unfolding before you, you're pinned to the ground and shackled. It's all downhill from there. You're taken to the dungeon and interrogated.
target_draft:
[sneak failure]右の部屋へ飛び込む。食堂だ。数人の使用人が食事の片づけをしており、全員が作業に目を落としている。大きな樫のテーブルの下へ転がり込むが、使用人の一人に見つかり警報を上げられる。

何が起きているのか理解する暇もなく、地面へ押さえつけられ、枷をはめられる。この先は転げ落ちるだけだ。地下牢へ連れていかれ、尋問を受ける。

source: [sneak success]You duck into the room on your right. It's a dining chamber. Several servants are clearing up a recent meal, their eyes fixed on their tasks. You react quickly, rolling under a large oak table before anyone can see you.
target_draft: [sneak success]右の部屋へ飛び込む。食堂だ。数人の使用人が食事の片づけをしており、全員が作業に目を落としている。素早く反応し、誰にも見られる前に大きな樫のテーブルの下へ転がり込む。

source: Wait for the servants to finish.
target_draft: 使用人たちが片づけを終えるまで待つ。

source: You're standing in front of the palisade. It's tall enough to shield you from the guards. Of course, you'll probably be wide open if you manage to get to the other side.
target_draft: 柵の前に立っている。衛兵から姿を隠せるだけの高さはある。もちろん、向こう側へ登り切ったら丸見えになるだろう。

source: [throwing]Use the rope with the grappling hook.
[dexterity][strength]Climb over the palisade without attracting the guards' attention.
target_draft: [dexterity][strength]衛兵に気づかれないよう柵を乗り越える。

source: [failure]You throw the rope several times, but somehow the hook fails to catch. You must be really bad at it.
target_draft: [failure]何度か縄を投げるが、どういうわけか鉤が引っかからない。よほど下手らしい。

source: [dexterity][strength]Climb over the palisade without attracting the guards' attention.
target_draft: [dexterity][strength]衛兵に気づかれないよう柵を乗り越える。

source: [failure]You try to climb but all you get is splinters for your trouble...
target_draft: [failure]登ろうとするが、手に刺さる木片以外は何も得られない……。

source: [throwing]Use the rope with the grappling hook.
[success]You throw the rope and get the grappling hook exactly where you want it. You can climb up without much effort now.
target_draft: [success]縄を投げ、狙いどおりの場所へ鉤をかける。これならほとんど苦労せず登れる。

source: [dexterity][strength]Climb up the rope and get over the palisade without attracting the guards' attention.
target_draft: [dexterity][strength]縄を登り、衛兵に気づかれないよう柵を越える。

source: [failure]You try to get over the palisade but fail miserably.
target_draft: [failure]柵を乗り越えようとするが、惨めなほど失敗する。

source:
[success]You climb the palisade without making a sound, none of the crossbowmen showing any sign of them having noticed your ascent.

Inside the palisade is a broad, open area used for training. Your only option is to make it to the shadows of the guard house 60 feet away before you are spotted and used for target practice.
target_draft:
[success]物音一つ立てずに柵を登る。弩兵たちは誰一人として、こちらが登ったことに気づいた様子を見せない。

柵の内側には、訓練に使われる広い空き地がある。見つかって射的の標的にされる前に、60フィート先の衛兵詰所の影までたどり着くしかない。

source:
[failure]You move as quickly and quietly as you can. You're halfway through when an impact of a bolt suddenly appearing in your chest throws you on your back. Gasping for air, you lift up your head and look around.

Before you can even grasp the situation unfolding before you, you're pinned to the ground and shackled. It's all downhill from there. You're taken to the dungeon and interrogated.
target_draft:
[failure]できるだけ素早く、静かに移動する。半分ほど進んだところで、突然胸に現れた弩の矢の衝撃に背中から倒される。息を求めて喘ぎながら頭を持ち上げ、周囲を見る。

何が起きているのか理解する暇もなく、地面へ押さえつけられ、枷をはめられる。この先は転げ落ちるだけだ。地下牢へ連れていかれ、尋問を受ける。

source: [success]You move like a ghost, giving the guards neither movement, nor sounds to react to. Before long, you stand within the temporary safety of the guard house's shadow, considering your options.
target_draft: [success]幽霊のように動き、衛兵に反応するための動きも音も与えない。ほどなく、衛兵詰所の影という一時的な安全地帯へたどり着き、次の手を考える。

source:
It looks like there are two ways to get inside the main building: over the roof or through the guard house, which is connected to the main building.

You can probably make it around the left corner and sneak into the guardhouse. Alternatively, you can climb to the second storey of the guard house and look for another way in. If running into people doesn't fit your plans you can sneak behind the buildings and find a good spot to get to the roof of the main building.

Also there is an old stone tower set in the town wall with a parapet connecting the second storey to the guard house.
target_draft:
本館へ入る方法は二つありそうだ。屋根を越えるか、本館につながっている衛兵詰所を通るか。

左角を回って衛兵詰所へ忍び込むことはできそうだ。あるいは衛兵詰所の二階へ登り、別の侵入口を探してもいい。人と出くわしたくないなら、建物の裏へ忍び、本館の屋根へ登るのに適した場所を探す手もある。

さらに、町の城壁には古い石造りの塔があり、二階から衛兵詰所へ胸壁付きの通路がつながっている。

source: [dexterity][strength]Climb to the second storey of the guard house.
Quietly make your way to the back of the palace and go to the east side of the compound.
target_draft: 静かに宮殿の裏手へ回り、敷地の東側へ向かう。

source:
[failure]You blend with the wall and start moving, carefully watching the guards. You cut the corner, being now no more than ten feet away from the guards. A misstep causes one of the guards to glance back, making sure that everything is in order, and within seconds all hell breaks loose.

Before you can even grasp the situation unfolding before you, you're pinned to the ground and shackled. It's all downhill from there. You're taken to the dungeon and interrogated.
target_draft:
[failure]壁に溶け込むようにして、衛兵たちを注意深く見ながら移動する。角を曲がると衛兵まで十フィートもない。足を滑らせたせいで衛兵の一人が振り返り、異常がないか確かめる。数秒後には地獄絵図だ。

何が起きているのか理解する暇もなく、地面へ押さえつけられ、枷をはめられる。この先は転げ落ちるだけだ。地下牢へ連れていかれ、尋問を受ける。

source: [success]You blend with the wall and start moving, carefully watching the guards. You cut the corner, being now no more than ten feet away from the guards, and keep moving slowly, barely breathing and checking your every step. Soon you reach the door, push it open and step inside.
target_draft: [success]壁に溶け込むようにして、衛兵たちを注意深く見ながら移動する。角を曲がると衛兵まで十フィートもない。それでも息を潜め、一歩一歩確かめながらゆっくり進む。やがて扉へたどり着き、押し開けて中へ入る。

source: [failure]You try to climb it, but the crumbling mortar makes it almost impossible for you to gain a hold.
target_draft: [failure]登ろうとするが、崩れかけた漆喰のせいで手掛かりを得るのもほとんど不可能だ。

source: [success]The building is old and could use some repair and maintenance. Missing bricks and crumbling mortar make climbing it barely more challenging than using a ladder.
target_draft: [success]建物は古く、修理も手入れも必要そうだ。抜けた煉瓦や崩れかけた漆喰のおかげで、梯子を使うのと大差ないほど簡単に登れる。

source: You approach the tower entrance. Inside, the ground floor serves as a makeshift storage area for weapons and water barrels. A ladder ascends to the next level, watched by a single guard sitting on a barrel. At the moment, his attention is focused on a fairly large topaz he's polishing with motherly love and affection.
target_draft: 塔の入口へ近づく。中では一階が武器や水樽を置く即席の物置として使われている。梯子が上階へ伸び、そのそばでは衛兵が一人、樽に座って見張っている。今はかなり大きなトパーズを、母親が子を慈しむような愛情で磨くことに夢中だ。

source: [critical strike]Take the guard out before he can call for help.
target_draft: [critical strike]助けを呼ばれる前に衛兵を始末する。

source:
[failure]Your attack catches the guard by surprise as he clearly didn't expect to be attacked within the compound. He falls backwards, thrashing around and choking on his own blood. He kicks the barrel he was sitting on, sending it into one of the weapon racks. As if all that noise wasn't enough, the guard manages to clear his throat of blood and produce a gut-wrenching scream that could wake the dead.

Before you can even grasp the situation unfolding before you, you're pinned to the ground and shackled. It's all downhill from there. You're taken to the dungeon and interrogated.
target_draft:
[failure]敷地内で襲われるとは思ってもいなかったのか、奇襲は衛兵を完全に捉える。男は後ろへ倒れ、のたうち回りながら自分の血で喉を詰まらせる。座っていた樽を蹴飛ばし、それが武器棚へ激突する。それだけの騒音でも十分なのに、衛兵は喉から血を吐き出し、死人まで起こしそうな凄まじい悲鳴を上げる。

何が起きているのか理解する暇もなく、地面へ押さえつけられ、枷をはめられる。この先は転げ落ちるだけだ。地下牢へ連れていかれ、尋問を受ける。

source: [success]Your attack catches the guard by surprise as he clearly didn't expect to be attacked within the compound. He falls backwards and lies motionless in a quickly expanding puddle of blood. You pick up the topaz and slowly go up the ladder.
target_draft: [success]敷地内で襲われるとは思ってもいなかったのか、奇襲は衛兵を完全に捉える。男は後ろへ倒れ、みるみる広がる血だまりの中で動かなくなる。トパーズを拾い、ゆっくり梯子を上る。

source:
In this small room on the outer wall, two guards are monitoring the approach to town through a pair of arrow loops. A centurion studies something in a small office between the apertures.

A makeshift bridge will take you to the guard house.
target_draft:
外壁に設けられた小部屋では、二人の衛兵が二つの矢狭間から町への進入路を監視している。矢狭間の間にある小さな詰所では、百人隊長が何かを調べている。

即席の橋を渡れば衛兵詰所へ行ける。

source: [critical strike][sneak]Take out the guards from behind, one by one, then deal with the centurion.
target_draft: [critical strike][sneak]背後から衛兵を一人ずつ始末し、それから百人隊長を片づける。
静かに衛兵詰所へ向かう。

source: [failure]Crouching, you move across the room like a shadow. You're about to reach out and cut his throat, when the guard whirls around, slashing you with his gladius. For a while, you attempt to keep your intestines from falling out, but it's not a game that you can win. Your death is quick but painful.
target_draft: [failure]身を低くし、影のように部屋を横切る。手を伸ばして喉を切り裂こうとした瞬間、衛兵が身を翻し、グラディウスで腹を切り開く。しばらくは腸がこぼれ落ちないよう押さえようとするが、勝てる勝負ではない。死は早いが、苦痛に満ちている。

source:
[success]Crouching, you move across the room like a shadow. When you get close enough, you lunge, clapping your hand over the guard's mouth as you ram your dagger between the man's ribs, then gently lower the body to the floor.

You take out the other guard without much difficulty. When you turn around you see the centurion standing outside of his office.

"Don't worry," he says after a pause. "I won't call for help. It's a matter of honour." Then he pulls out his sword.
target_draft:
[success]身を低くし、影のように部屋を横切る。十分近づくと飛びかかり、男の口を手で塞ぎながら短剣を肋骨の間へ突き込み、死体を静かに床へ横たえる。

もう一人の衛兵も大した苦労なく始末する。振り返ると、百人隊長が詰所の外に立っている。

「心配するな」少し間を置いて男が言う。「助けは呼ばん。これは名誉の問題だ。」そう言って剣を抜く。
speaker: Centurion

source:
The centurion finally goes down. He looks surprised – it's certainly not the outcome he expected.

You carefully unfasten his armor and helmet, and wipe off the blood. You pack the rest neatly into your backpack - an old bag with faded lettering you bought from a man who claimed to be an arcanist a long time ago.
target_draft:
ようやく百人隊長が倒れる。本人は驚いた顔をしている――少なくとも、こんな結末は想定していなかったのだろう。

鎧と兜を慎重に外し、血を拭き取る。残りもきれいに背負い袋へ詰め込む。昔、自称秘術師の男から買った、色褪せた文字入りの古い袋だ。

source: Put them on and go to the main building.
target_draft: 身につけて本館へ向かう。

source: "Who are you and what are you doing here?" Flavius hand finds the sword's pommel and rests there comfortably. For now.
target_draft: 「何者だ、ここで何をしている？」フラウィウスの手が剣の柄へ伸び、そのまま自然にそこへ置かれる。今のところは。
speaker: Flavius

source: "I was told to report to you. I want to work for House Daratan."
target_draft: 「あなたのところへ出頭しろと言われた。ダラタン家で働きたい。」
speaker: Flavius

source: "What are you doing here, <charname>?" asks Flavius.
target_draft: 「ここで何をしている、<charname>？」フラウィウスが尋ねる。
speaker: Flavius

source: "I was told to report to you. I want to work for House Daratan."
target_draft: 「あなたのところへ出頭しろと言われた。ダラタン家で働きたい。」
speaker: Flavius

source: "Indeed. However, I feel that I must give my man a chance to redeem himself. I hope you will have no objections."
target_draft: 「まったくだ。だが、部下には汚名をそそぐ機会を与えるべきだと思っている。異論はないな？」
speaker: Flavius

source:

source:
Neleos, the guildmaster of Teron's assassins, always smiled. He smiled when he talked to people, as if he was just told a good joke, and he smiled when he had to kill, which, in his mind, was a joke life played on his victims. Since the dead are good at keeping secrets, few people thought of Neleos as an assassin, and the general consensus was that Neleos was strictly an administrator of the guild, rather than someone who killed for a living.

"Perfect timing, <charname>. I've just got a contract on a merchant who arrived this morning. His name is Gracius, and he is staying at the inn. He should be dead before morning. The Commercium - the merchants guild - has a special request. Before you kill Gracius, tell him that the Commercium wishes to remind him that he's *still* not welcome in this town. The job is worth fifty imperials. Ten now, the rest upon completion. Any questions?"

source:
Using numerous holes and rough patches as footholds, you easily climb the crumbling wall of the inn, reach the window and slip into the room. The merchant is awake, talking to his bodyguard and pointing at a chest. The bodyguard doesn't look like a fighting man - most likely one of the local brawlers who sell the guests a false sense of security for a few imperials.

Sensing your presence, the merchant turns around. He looks at the aimed crossbow, at the dull metal of the loaded bolt, and opens his mouth to say something - to object or bargain for his life. Still, fear takes over and he continues to stare at the crossbow, like a rabbit mesmerized by a snake. The bodyguard finally wakes up and starts reaching for his sword.
target_ja:
崩れかけた宿屋の壁には穴や粗い部分が多く、足場には事欠かない。難なく壁を登り、窓までたどり着くと部屋へ忍び込んだ。商人はまだ起きており、用心棒と話しながら宝箱を指さしている。用心棒は戦い慣れた男には見えない。数インペリアルと引き換えに、客へ偽りの安心を売る地元のごろつきだろう。

気配を察した商人が振り返る。こちらに向けられたクロスボウ、装填された太矢の鈍い金属光を見て、何か言おうと口を開いた。抗議するか、命乞いの取引を持ちかけるつもりだったのだろう。だが恐怖に呑まれ、蛇に見入られた兎のようにクロスボウを見つめ続ける。ようやく事態を悟った用心棒が剣へ手を伸ばした。
notes: First-pass Japanese translation; protected gameplay tags retained.

source:

source:
"Guilds, same as everywhere else. Try to go into business for yourself, you'll get fucked over fast. Unless you've got the numbers and the swords behind you, and if you do, well, maybe you become part of the problem.

"Just look at the Commercium. Two decades back they were nothing more than a bunch of farmers who got tired of the traders paying them shit for their produce. So, they teamed up, hired some muscle, picked a name that sounded big and went into the trading business for themselves.

"Soon enough they realized they could set the prices if they got more farmers to join them. But farmers are a stubborn folk, many preferred to stay independent. That's where the muscle came in handy, and once you start on that road, it doesn't take much to take the next step, does it?

source:
The Forty Thieves guild is a large and seemingly indefatigable network of thieves, smugglers, and other criminally inclined citizens. The guild operates in every town and traces its origin to the early days of the Empire. It is said that in the past, the forty kingpins of the forty largest towns used to coordinate the network. Opinion is divided as to the relations and ties of the Forty Thieves of yore and its current incarnation, but the name persists.

In Teron the guild operates out of a local tavern – a popular destination for people who feel at home in shady parts of town and dark alleys. The tavern is full of people laughing, arguing, and drinking. At the back of the tavern piles of loot sit atop tables, waiting to be counted and divvied. At the far end of the room Cado conducts his business while keeping an eye on the guests.
target_ja:
四十人盗賊団は、盗賊、密輸業者、その他犯罪に手を染めた市民からなる、巨大で疲れを知らないかのような組織網だ。ギルドはあらゆる町で活動し、その起源は帝国初期まで遡る。かつては四十の大都市を支配する四十人の顔役が、組織網を取りまとめていたと言われている。往時の四十人盗賊団と現在の組織にどれほどの関係や繋がりがあるのかは意見が分かれるが、その名だけは残っている。

テルオンでは、ギルドは地元の酒場を拠点としている。町の怪しげな一角や暗い路地を居心地よく感じる者たちに人気の場所だ。酒場は笑い、口論し、酒を飲む人々で溢れている。奥の卓上には戦利品の山が積まれ、数えられ分配されるのを待っている。部屋の最奥では、カドが客に目を配りながら商売を取り仕切っている。

source:
The Forty Thieves guild is a large and seemingly indefatigable network of thieves, smugglers, and other criminally inclined citizens. The guild operates in every town and traces its origin to the early days of the Empire. It is said that in the past, the forty kingpins of the forty largest towns used to coordinate the network. Opinion is divided as to the relations and ties of the Forty Thieves of yore and its current incarnation, but the name persists.

In Teron, the guild operates out of a local tavern – a popular destination for people who feel at home in shady parts of town and dark alleys. The tavern is full of people laughing, arguing, and drinking. At the back of the tavern, piles of loot sit atop tables, waiting to be counted and divvied. At the far end of the room, Cado conducts his business while keeping an eye on the guests.

source:
In the halcyon days of the Empire, the Emperor commanded his own guard. Apart from their regular duties of protection for the Emperor, they were trained as experts in infiltration and assassination. Many political and military opponents would meet with unexplainable misfortune or death in the rapture of night, ensuring the long-standing stability of the Empire. After the fall, without a master to serve, the guard disbanded into the chaos of the fallen empire. Once outside they found that even as the world lay in ruins, their peacekeeping services were in great demand. An Assassins' Order was established that later bore the proud name of the Regiment – the Boatmen of Styx.

You enter the Boatmen of Styx guild. The business-like nature of the establishment is very clear. The hall is lacking any decoration or flamboyance and the patrons are mostly silent. There are no guards anywhere in the room.

source: Cado has been a thief ever since he could remember. Unlike many people who thought that stealing was a quick and easy way to make money, Cado believes that stealing is a job, and like any job it requires a lot of time and effort, rewarding hard work and dedication. Running a thieves guild in a small town is a difficult and dangerous occupation, and the guild was hit hard several times in the not so recent past. source:
"Where does anything come from? The olden days. It's all about prestige. Everyone wants to show that we were *there*, that our blood is noble. As if anyone really cares.

"The way the story goes, ours is the oldest profession. What one man has, be it jewels, gold, or a shiny stone, another man wants. Such is the way of the world. And as this world grew, so too did we. We banded together, wrote our own laws, chose our leaders. We created a society within a society. We had our wars, of course – some differences can only be resolved with blood. We grew until there was one man controlling each city and forty men controlling the shadow society of the Empire."
target_ja:
「何にだって由来はある。昔の時代だ。要は名誉の問題さ。誰もが自分たちは*そこにいた*、高貴な血を引いていると示したがる。実際には誰も気にしないのにな。

「話によれば、我々は最古の職業だ。宝石、金、光る石ころ。誰かが持つ物を、別の誰かが欲しがる。世の中とはそういうものだ。世界が大きくなるにつれ、我々も成長した。徒党を組み、自分たちの法を書き、指導者を選んだ。社会の中にもう一つの社会を作った。もちろん戦争もあった。血でしか解決できない違いもある。やがて各都市を一人が支配し、四十人が帝国の影の社会を支配するまでになった」
